creators.name: Dan Miller
creators.role: XR developer advocate; former Unity AR evangelist
creators.role_zh: XR 开发者布道师，前 Unity AR 技术布道师
creators.bio: San Francisco XR developer who spent years at Unity showing how AR Foundation works, and who open-sourced small samples that put URP post-processing, Shader Graph and VFX Graph on top of the phone camera.
creators.bio_zh: 旧金山的 XR 开发者，在 Unity 工作多年，专门演示 AR Foundation 的用法，并开源了一批小样例，把 URP 后处理、Shader Graph 和 VFX Graph 叠加到手机摄像头画面上。
creators.why: His minimal repos were among the first to prove that Unity's high-end VFX tools run in mobile AR, so they are ideal starting projects for students.
creators.why_zh: 他的精简仓库最早证明了 Unity 的高端特效工具可以在手机 AR 里运行，是学生入门的理想起点工程。

creators.name: Marek Šimoník (Record3D)
creators.role_zh: Record3D 应用开发者
creators.bio: Independent developer of Record3D, an iPhone/iPad app that records and streams TrueDepth and LiDAR depth video, with open Unity demos that feed the stream into VFX Graph.
creators.bio_zh: 独立开发者，开发了 Record3D：一款能录制并实时传输 iPhone/iPad 的 TrueDepth 与 LiDAR 深度视频的应用，并开源了把这路数据送进 VFX Graph 的 Unity 示例。
creators.why: Record3D turned any recent iPhone into a Kinect-style depth camera for real-time VFX, and his demo repo shows the whole pipeline.
creators.why_zh: Record3D 让任何一台较新的 iPhone 都能变成类似 Kinect 的实时特效深度相机，他的示例仓库完整展示了这条管线。

creators.name: Koki Ibukuro (asus4)
creators.role_zh: 自由职业创意技术专家
creators.bio: Japanese creative technologist in Berlin who maintains the TensorFlow Lite and ONNX Runtime plugins for Unity and builds AR experiments that run neural networks on the phone camera in real time.
creators.bio_zh: 生活在柏林的日本创意技术专家，维护 Unity 的 TensorFlow Lite 与 ONNX Runtime 插件，并用它们做在手机摄像头上实时运行神经网络的 AR 实验。
creators.why: He makes on-device machine learning usable for AR artists, and his experiments show what segmentation and face models can do as visual effects.
creators.why_zh: 他让端侧机器学习真正能被 AR 艺术家使用，他的实验展示了分割和人脸模型作为视觉特效能做什么。

creators.name: Satoshi Hattori
creators.role_zh: iOS 与 visionOS 工程师
creators.bio: Tokyo engineer who ran a public '100 days AR challenge' in 2021, posting one ARKit, Metal or Unity effect per day with the source on GitHub, and later did the same for visionOS.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的工程师，2021 年在网上发起“100 天 AR 挑战”，每天发布一个用 ARKit、Metal 或 Unity 实现的效果并把源码放到 GitHub，后来又为 visionOS 做了同样的挑战。
creators.why: His daily LiDAR, people-occlusion and face-mesh sketches form an open library of AR effects that each fit in one small, readable project.
creators.why_zh: 他每天一个的 LiDAR、人物遮挡和人脸网格小作品，构成了一个开源的 AR 特效库，每个效果都是一个小而易读的工程。

creators.name: Thomas Ratliff
creators.role_zh: 独立 XR 游戏开发者
creators.bio: Independent VR/MR game developer (Party Crashers) who posts mixed-reality experiments on Meta Quest 3, from passthrough camera shaders to LiDAR-style particle scans of his room.
creators.bio_zh: 独立 VR/MR 游戏开发者（代表作 Party Crashers），经常发布在 Meta Quest 3 上做的混合现实实验，从透视摄像头着色器到像 LiDAR 一样扫描房间的粒子效果。
creators.why: He treats the Quest passthrough image as a canvas and contributed his camera shaders to an open-source toolkit.
creators.why_zh: 他把 Quest 的透视画面当作画布，并把自己的摄像头着色器贡献给了一个开源工具包。

creators.name: Roberto Coviello
creators.role_zh: XR 与 AI 工程师
creators.bio: Zurich-based XR engineer who maintains QuestCameraKit, an open collection of Unity samples for the Meta Quest Passthrough Camera API: color sampling, object detection, camera shaders and streaming.
creators.bio_zh: 常驻苏黎世的 XR 工程师，维护 QuestCameraKit：一套基于 Meta Quest 透视摄像头 API 的开源 Unity 示例，包括取色、物体检测、摄像头着色器和视频推流。
creators.why: QuestCameraKit is the most complete open starting point for effects that read the headset's real camera image.
creators.why_zh: QuestCameraKit 是目前最完整的开源起点，可以做读取头显真实摄像头画面的特效。

creators.name: Julien Kipp (julienkay)
creators.role_zh: XR 与神经渲染开发者
creators.bio: German Unity developer who ports research renderers to Unity, including MobileNeRF, SNeRG and MERF viewers, Google's layered light-field video and Sentis packages for depth estimation and diffusion.
creators.bio_zh: 德国的 Unity 开发者，把研究界的渲染方法移植进 Unity，包括 MobileNeRF、SNeRG、MERF 查看器，Google 的分层光场视频，以及用于深度估计和扩散模型的 Sentis 插件。
creators.why: He makes neural and volumetric capture formats playable in a game engine and on headsets, with every port open-sourced.
creators.why_zh: 他让神经渲染和体积捕捉格式能在游戏引擎和头显里直接播放，而且所有移植都开源。

creators.name: Jure Triglav
creators.role_zh: WebXR 与开放科学软件开发者
creators.based_zh: 卢布尔雅那，斯洛文尼亚
creators.bio: Slovenian developer who builds open-science tools and WebXR experiments, including Shaderworlds, which puts raymarched Shadertoy worlds into a VR headset through the browser.
creators.bio_zh: 斯洛文尼亚的开发者，做开放科学工具和 WebXR 实验，其中 Shaderworlds 通过浏览器把光线步进的 Shadertoy 世界放进 VR 头显。
creators.why: Shaderworlds shows how a fragment shader can become a space you stand inside, with nothing to install.
creators.why_zh: Shaderworlds 展示了一个片元着色器如何变成人可以站在其中的空间，而且无需安装任何东西。

creators.name: Arghya Sur (Genesis Interactive)
creators.role: XR developer; founder of Genesis Interactive
creators.role_zh: XR 开发者，Genesis Interactive 创始人
creators.bio: Indian XR developer behind Genesis Interactive, a VR/AI studio that open-sourced QuestRoomScan, a real-time room reconstruction and Gaussian-splat pipeline for Meta Quest 3.
creators.bio_zh: 印度 XR 开发者，创办 VR/AI 工作室 Genesis Interactive，开源了 QuestRoomScan：一套在 Meta Quest 3 上实时重建房间并生成高斯泼溅的管线。
creators.why: QuestRoomScan turns a headset into a live scanner, making the room itself available as material for mixed-reality effects.
creators.why_zh: QuestRoomScan 把头显变成实时扫描仪，让房间本身成为混合现实特效的素材。

creators.name: Yasuhito Nagatomo
creators.role_zh: visionOS 与 iOS 开发者
creators.bio: Tokyo visionOS and iOS developer who publishes small open samples for RealityKit, ARKit and Shader Graph materials, often with a short screen recording on X.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的 visionOS 与 iOS 开发者，持续发布 RealityKit、ARKit 和 Shader Graph 材质的开源小样例，通常在 X 上配一段简短的录屏。
creators.why: His Shader Graph Material examples are the clearest open reference for writing visual effects on Apple Vision Pro.
creators.why_zh: 他的 Shader Graph 材质示例是在 Apple Vision Pro 上编写视觉特效最清晰的开源参考。

creators.name: Masatatsu Nakamura (mattatz)
creators.role_zh: 图形与工具程序员
creators.bio: Tokyo programmer who has open-sourced dozens of Unity geometry and GPU-simulation projects (voxelizer, Teddy, cellular growth, volume rendering) and now builds the browser CAD tool Nodi.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的程序员，开源了几十个 Unity 几何与 GPU 模拟项目（体素化、Teddy、细胞生长、体渲染），现在在开发浏览器端的 CAD 工具 Nodi。
creators.why: Each repository isolates one geometry algorithm and turns it into a moving image, so students can read a single clean implementation and reuse it.
creators.why_zh: 他的每个仓库只讲一种几何算法，并把它变成会动的画面，学生可以读懂一份干净的实现再拿去复用。

creators.name: Angela He (zephyo)
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发者、艺术家
creators.bio: Artist-programmer who makes small narrative games and shares short Unity visual experiments (rain, anime skies, hair physics) with full source.
creators.bio_zh: 会画画也会写代码的游戏作者，做小型叙事游戏，并把一个个 Unity 视觉小实验（雨、动漫天空、头发物理）连同完整源码公开。
creators.why: Her experiments show how far RenderTextures and Shader Graph go in a 2D/2.5D scene, each posted as a short clip with the code.
creators.why_zh: 她的实验展示了 RenderTexture 和 Shader Graph 在 2D/2.5D 场景里能做到什么程度，每个都配一段短视频和代码。

creators.name: Eyez
creators.role_zh: 实时图形艺术家
creators.bio: Real-time CG artist (formerly in Tokyo) who explores compute-shader simulations such as physarum, cellular automata and boids, and built a LiDAR-driven VFX Graph toolkit for iPad AR.
creators.bio_zh: 实时 CG 艺术家（曾在东京），用计算着色器探索黏菌、元胞自动机、鸟群等模拟，并做了一套在 iPad 上由 LiDAR 驱动的 VFX Graph AR 工具包。
creators.why: ARVolumeVFX is one of the few open toolkits that feeds LiDAR scene meshes and human stencils straight into VFX Graph particles on a phone.
creators.why_zh: ARVolumeVFX 是少数几个开源工具之一，能在手机上把 LiDAR 场景网格和人像遮罩直接送进 VFX Graph 粒子。

creators.name: setchi
creators.role_zh: Unity 工程师
creators.bio: Japanese Unity engineer known for the FancyScrollView UI library, who also writes compact animated ShaderLab sketches and GLSL tweets.
creators.bio_zh: 日本的 Unity 工程师，以 UI 库 FancyScrollView 闻名，也写短小的 ShaderLab 动画草图和“推特长度”的 GLSL。
creators.why: His shader sketches prove that a few lines of fragment code can produce a hypnotic pattern ready to texture any surface.
creators.why_zh: 他的着色器草图说明：几行片元代码就能做出催眠般的图案，随时贴到任何表面上。

creators.name: kaiware007
creators.role_zh: Unity 工程师、VJ
creators.bio: Japanese Unity engineer and VJ who shares GPU particle, plexus, hex-tiling and image-effect samples, plus slides from Unity shader study meetups.
creators.bio_zh: 日本的 Unity 工程师兼 VJ，分享 GPU 粒子、Plexus、六边形平铺和画面特效等示例，以及 Unity 着色器学习会的讲稿项目。
creators.why: He recreates effects people know from games and VJ sets in small, readable Unity projects.
creators.why_zh: 他把大家在游戏和 VJ 现场见过的效果，重做成小而易读的 Unity 项目。

creators.name: Nakata Nobuyuki (nobnak)
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术装置图形程序员
creators.bio: Tokyo programmer who builds real-time graphics for large digital-art installations and has open-sourced many Unity effects since 2013: watercolour filters, caustics, light streaks, smoke blur.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的程序员，为大型数字艺术装置做实时图形，从 2013 年起开源了许多 Unity 特效：水彩滤镜、焦散、光芒拖尾、烟雾模糊。
creators.why: His repos turn classic graphics papers (Kawase streaks, height-field caustics, procedural watercolour) into drop-in Unity effects with a demo video each.
creators.why_zh: 他把经典图形学论文（Kawase 光芒、高度场焦散、程序化水彩）做成可直接放进 Unity 的特效，每个都配有演示视频。

creators.name: Hiroaki Oishi (irishoak)
creators.role_zh: VJ、交互程序员
creators.bio: Tokyo VJ and programmer who performs at club events such as BRDG's CHANNEL series and publishes Unity post-processing, GPU fluid and TouchDesigner experiments.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的 VJ 和程序员，常在 BRDG 的 CHANNEL 等俱乐部活动中演出，并公开 Unity 后期处理、GPU 流体和 TouchDesigner 实验。
creators.why: His effects come straight from live VJ practice: fast, reactive and built to run on a single GPU all night.
creators.why_zh: 他的特效直接来自 VJ 现场：快速、有反应，并且能在一块 GPU 上整晚稳定运行。

creators.name: EsProgram
creators.role_zh: Unity 工程师
creators.bio: Tokyo Unity engineer behind InkPainter, a widely used open-source texture-painting library, and its companion water-wave shaders.
creators.bio_zh: 东京的 Unity 工程师，开源了被广泛使用的纹理绘制库 InkPainter，以及与之配套的水波着色器。
creators.why: InkPainter lets any mesh be painted at runtime, which is exactly what an AR app needs to let people draw onto the real world.
creators.why_zh: InkPainter 让任何网格都能在运行时被涂画，这正是 AR 应用让人在真实世界上作画所需要的能力。

creators.name: Codrin Mihail (Kodrin)
creators.role_zh: 技术美术、交互开发者
creators.bio: Montreal technical artist working across Unity, Houdini and Unreal who open-sourced the URP-PSX retro shader kit, a compute-shader flow field and an HDRP VFX Graph workshop.
creators.bio_zh: 蒙特利尔的技术美术，横跨 Unity、Houdini 和 Unreal，开源了复古着色器套件 URP-PSX、计算着色器流场和一套 HDRP VFX Graph 工作坊。
creators.why: He packages what he learns into teaching material: every sample in his VFX Graph workshop is documented and free.
creators.why_zh: 他把学到的东西整理成教学材料：VFX Graph 工作坊里的每个示例都有文档并且免费。

creators.name: Cyan (Cyanilux)
creators.role_zh: 着色器艺术家、教程作者
creators.bio: Hobbyist Unity shader artist who posts stylised Shader Graph effects (water, fire, forcefields, CRT) and writes in-depth breakdowns and URP tools on cyanilux.com.
creators.bio_zh: 业余的 Unity 着色器艺术家，发布风格化的 Shader Graph 效果（水、火、力场、CRT），并在 cyanilux.com 写详细拆解和 URP 工具。
creators.why: Cyan's breakdowns are among the clearest Shader Graph teaching material online, and the key effects ship as open URP repositories.
creators.why_zh: Cyan 的拆解是网上最清楚的 Shader Graph 教学材料之一，关键效果还以开源 URP 仓库发布。

creators.name: Leon Denise
creators.role_zh: 着色器艺术家、设计师、开发者
creators.bio: Paris shader artist from the demoscene who live-codes at Cookie Demoparty, teaches shader workshops and publishes Unity, Godot and Shadertoy experiments.
creators.bio_zh: 来自 demoscene 的巴黎着色器艺术家，在 Cookie Demoparty 现场写代码、教授着色器工作坊，并发布 Unity、Godot 和 Shadertoy 实验。
creators.why: He treats shaders as a sketchbook and shares the small tools and templates behind his pieces.
creators.why_zh: 他把着色器当作速写本，并把作品背后的小工具和模板一起分享出来。

creators.name: AMAGI (Takayosi Amagi)
creators.role_zh: Web 图形开发者、VJ
creators.bio: Japanese web-graphics developer and VJ, author of the VEDA live-coding environment and the VFX-JS / REACT-VFX WebGL effect libraries, who also builds Unity VJ systems.
creators.bio_zh: 日本的 Web 图形开发者和 VJ，开发了现场编程环境 VEDA 以及 WebGL 特效库 VFX-JS / REACT-VFX，也做 Unity VJ 系统。
creators.why: He moves effects freely between the browser, Unity and live shows, and publishes the code for most of them.
creators.why_zh: 他让特效在浏览器、Unity 和现场演出之间自由流动，并公开了其中大部分代码。

creators.name: Acerola (Garrett Gunnell)
creators.role_zh: 图形程序员、YouTube 教学作者
creators.bio: Garrett Gunnell makes long-form videos as Acerola in which he rebuilds a rendering effect from a game or a paper (smoke, water, fur, pixel sorting, painterly filters) and publishes the Unity or Godot project on GitHub.
creators.bio_zh: Garrett Gunnell 以 Acerola 为名制作长篇视频：每期从某个游戏或论文出发，亲手重做一种渲染效果（烟雾、海洋、毛发、像素排序、绘画风滤镜），并把 Unity 或 Godot 工程开源在 GitHub 上。
creators.why: Each video pairs a striking real-time effect with a clear explanation of the math and a public repository, so students can go from idea to working shader in one sitting.
creators.why_zh: 每期视频都把一个抓眼的实时效果、清楚的数学讲解和公开仓库放在一起，学生看完就能从想法走到能跑的着色器。

creators.name: Benoit Arbelot
creators.role_zh: 创意工程师、数字艺术家
creators.bio: French creative engineer who builds his own fluid and Physarum (slime-mould) simulation frameworks in Unity and uses them for short real-time films such as Lights of Nibel and Coriolis.
creators.bio_zh: 法国创意工程师，在 Unity 里自己写流体和多头绒泡菌（黏菌）模拟框架，并用它们制作《Lights of Nibel》《Coriolis》等实时短片。
creators.why: He open-sources the simulation frameworks behind his films, so the same code that makes a finished piece can be studied and reused.
creators.why_zh: 他把短片背后的模拟框架开源，完成作品所用的同一套代码可以直接拿来学习和复用。

creators.name: Erik Nordeus (Habrador)
creators.role: Developer, technical artist and tutorial author
creators.role_zh: 开发者、技术美术、教程作者
creators.bio: Swedish engineer who publishes Unity tutorials and open-source simulations under the name Habrador, from fluid solvers and tornadoes to ray-marched and parallax shaders.
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典工程师，以 Habrador 为名发布 Unity 教程和开源模拟：从流体解算、龙卷风到光线步进和视差着色器。
creators.why: His small, well-documented projects show a single physics or shader idea clearly enough to rebuild in a class.
creators.why_zh: 他的项目小而文档齐全，把一个物理或着色器点子讲得足够清楚，课堂上就能重做。

creators.name: Ming Wai Chan (cinight)
creators.role_zh: 图形开发者
creators.bio: Copenhagen-based graphics developer who keeps MinimalCompute, a widely used set of minimal Unity compute-shader scenes, plus custom SRP and shader samples, and posts short demo videos of each.
creators.bio_zh: 常驻哥本哈根的图形开发者，维护着被广泛使用的 MinimalCompute（一组最小化的 Unity 计算着色器示例场景），以及自定义渲染管线和着色器示例，并为每个示例发布简短演示视频。
creators.why: The minimal scenes strip GPU effects down to the few lines that matter, which makes them ideal starting points for AR experiments.
creators.why_zh: 这些示例把 GPU 特效精简到最关键的几行代码，是做 AR 实验的理想起点。

creators.name: Deniz Bicer
creators.role_zh: 创意编程者、Unity 开发者
creators.bio: Creative coder who explores Physarum (slime-mould) simulations, flow agents and pixel sorting with Unity compute shaders and later published an interactive explainer of the Physarum algorithm.
creators.bio_zh: 创意编程者，用 Unity 计算着色器探索多头绒泡菌（黏菌）模拟、流动智能体和像素排序，之后还发布了一篇讲解黏菌算法的交互式文章。
creators.why: The open Physarum implementation and playful variations (vector fields, image stimuli) make a complex emergent system easy to try.
creators.why_zh: 开源的黏菌实现和各种好玩的变体（矢量场、图像刺激）让一个复杂的涌现系统变得容易上手。

creators.name: Aman Tiwari
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、程序员
creators.bio: Artist and programmer who came through Golan Levin's courses at Carnegie Mellon and works across real-time graphics, openFrameworks and machine learning; his MeshToSDF converter became a standard companion to Unity's VFX Graph.
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家兼程序员，出自卡内基梅隆大学 Golan Levin 的课程，横跨实时图形、openFrameworks 和机器学习；他写的 MeshToSDF 转换器成了 Unity VFX Graph 的常用搭档。
creators.why: One small open tool of his unlocked a whole family of effects: particles that cling to and flow over animated meshes in real time.
creators.why_zh: 他的一个小型开源工具打开了一整类特效：粒子实时附着并流过动画网格。

creators.name: Owen (owenyuwono)
creators.role: Developer and founder of Pixel8 Labs
creators.role_zh: 开发者、Pixel8 Labs 创始人
creators.bio: Indonesian developer who in 2026 open-sourced a run of three.js + WebGPU prototypes: an FFT ocean (Poseidon), an SPH fluid (Tiamat), procedural grass (Gaia) and trees (Dryad).
creators.bio_zh: 印度尼西亚开发者，2026 年开源了一系列 three.js + WebGPU 原型：FFT 海洋（Poseidon）、SPH 流体（Tiamat）、程序化草地（Gaia）和树木（Dryad）。
creators.why: His browser-only simulations run on phones and are open source, so they are a direct path to WebXR effects.
creators.why_zh: 他的模拟只需浏览器、能在手机上运行而且开源，是通向 WebXR 特效的捷径。

creators.name: World of Zero (Sam Wronski)
creators.role_zh: 开发者、YouTube 着色器教学作者
creators.bio: Sam Wronski runs the World of Zero YouTube channel, live-building Unity shaders and image effects such as a revealing flashlight, an energy shield and a night-vision camera, and collects them in the open UnityVisualizations repository.
creators.bio_zh: Sam Wronski 运营 YouTube 频道 World of Zero，在视频里从零实现 Unity 着色器和画面特效，例如“显形手电筒”、能量护盾和夜视镜头，并把它们整理进开源仓库 UnityVisualizations。
creators.why: Each episode turns one small shader trick into a complete, reusable effect with source, a good pace for a classroom.
creators.why_zh: 每一期都把一个小的着色器技巧做成完整、可复用的效果并附上源码，节奏非常适合课堂。

creators.name: Przemyslaw Zaworski
creators.role_zh: 图形程序员
creators.bio: Polish programmer who has published hundreds of small Unity shaders and compute-shader demos since 2016, many of them ShaderToy ports, each with a short YouTube video and MIT-licensed source.
creators.bio_zh: 波兰程序员，自 2016 年起发布了数百个 Unity 着色器和计算着色器小样，其中不少移植自 ShaderToy，每个都配有简短的 YouTube 视频和 MIT 许可的源码。
creators.why: His Unity3D-CG-programming repository is a huge open sketchbook: one file per effect, easy to drop into an AR project.
creators.why_zh: 他的 Unity3D-CG-programming 仓库是一本巨大的开源速写本：一个效果一个文件，很容易直接放进 AR 项目。

creators.name: CJT (CJT-Jackton)
creators.role_zh: 着色器开发者
creators.bio: Graphics developer who publishes compact URP shader studies (crystal caustics, iridescence, anime crystal, knitwear) and an early mixed-reality theater system for HoloLens and Magic Leap.
creators.bio_zh: 图形开发者，发布了一系列精简的 URP 着色器研究（水晶焦散、虹彩、动漫水晶、针织材质），以及一个面向 HoloLens 和 Magic Leap 的早期混合现实剧场系统。
creators.why: Shows how a physically inspired effect such as caustics can be faked cheaply in real time, and how stage effects can be shared across AR glasses.
creators.why_zh: 展示了焦散这类基于物理的效果如何在实时中低成本地“伪造”出来，以及舞台特效如何在多副 AR 眼镜间同步呈现。

creators.name: Robin Seibold
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发者、开发日志视频作者
creators.bio: Swedish game developer who documents his stylised Unity rendering in carefully edited devlogs and open-sources the pieces, including a URP cel shader and a screen-space outline renderer feature.
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典游戏开发者，用精心剪辑的开发日志记录他的 Unity 风格化渲染，并把其中的部件开源，包括 URP 卡通着色器和屏幕空间描边渲染功能。
creators.why: His devlogs explain the thinking behind each rendering choice, and both repositories are small enough to study in one session.
creators.why_zh: 他的开发日志讲清了每个渲染选择背后的思路，两个仓库都小到可以在一次课里读完。

creators.name: MatrixRex
creators.role_zh: Unity 开发者、3D 美术
creators.bio: Frontend and Unity developer from Dhaka who builds editor tools and stylised shaders, and released the highly customisable Uber Stylized Water shader for Unity 6 URP.
creators.bio_zh: 来自达卡的前端和 Unity 开发者，制作编辑器工具和风格化着色器，发布了可高度自定义的 Unity 6 URP 着色器 Uber Stylized Water。
creators.why: A complete, well-documented stylised water shader is a ready building block for AR puddles, ponds and portals.
creators.why_zh: 一套完整且文档齐全的风格化水面着色器，可以直接用来做 AR 里的水洼、池塘和传送门。

creators.name: Tooster (T3sT3ro)
creators.role_zh: 程序员
creators.bio: Programmer who built SdfManipulator, an interactive Unity editor for raymarched signed-distance-field scenes that generates HLSL shaders from gizmo-driven primitives, as his bachelor's thesis.
creators.bio_zh: 程序员，本科毕业设计做了 SdfManipulator：一个在 Unity 里交互式编辑光线步进 SDF 场景的编辑器，用可拖拽的基本体自动生成 HLSL 着色器。
creators.why: Turns SDF modelling, normally written by hand in shader code, into direct manipulation that students can play with.
creators.why_zh: 把原本需要手写着色器代码的 SDF 建模变成可以直接拖拽操作的工具，学生可以上手玩。

creators.name: Thibaud Goiffon (HeyTibo)
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发者、技术美术
creators.bio: Game developer publishing as HeyTibo who shares quick Godot 4 visual-effect sketches, shaders and characters, and open-sourced the whole VFX sketchbook under MIT.
creators.bio_zh: 以 HeyTibo 为名发布作品的游戏开发者，分享用 Godot 4 做的快速视觉特效草图、着色器和角色，并以 MIT 许可开源了整本 VFX 速写本。
creators.why: Proves that expressive stylised VFX do not need a big engine: every sketch is small, readable and free to reuse.
creators.why_zh: 证明富有表现力的风格化特效不必依赖大型引擎：每个草图都小巧、易读、可以自由复用。

creators.name: Andy Duboc
creators.role_zh: 创意技术人
creators.bio: Montreal-based creative coder whose open Unity shader tests (hologram, frosted glass, Shader Graph sandbox, reaction-diffusion) became standard references, and who now makes real-time installations.
creators.bio_zh: 常驻蒙特利尔的创意程序员，他开源的 Unity 着色器实验（全息、磨砂玻璃、Shader Graph 示例集、反应扩散）成了常被引用的参考，现在也做实时影像装置。
creators.why: His small, clean shader repos show one material idea at a time, which makes them easy to adapt for AR.
creators.why_zh: 他的着色器仓库小而干净，每次只展示一个材质点子，很容易改造成 AR 效果。

creators.name: Rune Skovbo Johansen
creators.role: Indie game developer and procedural-generation researcher
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏开发者、程序化生成研究者
creators.bio: Indie developer behind The Cluster and LayerProcGen who invented Surface-Stable Fractal Dithering, a dither pattern that sticks to 3D surfaces and keeps constant dot size as you move.
creators.bio_zh: 独立开发者，作品包括 The Cluster 和 LayerProcGen，他发明了“表面稳定分形抖动”：一种贴在三维表面上、镜头移动时点的大小始终不变的抖动图案。
creators.why: A genuinely new rendering idea, explained step by step in video and released as open shader code.
creators.why_zh: 一个真正新颖的渲染点子，用视频一步步讲清楚，并以开源着色器代码发布。

creators.name: Michal Skalsky
creators.role_zh: 图形程序员
creators.bio: Graphics programmer who released an open-source volumetric lighting system for Unity in 2016, raymarching light shafts for point, spot and directional lights.
creators.bio_zh: 图形程序员，2016 年开源了一套 Unity 体积光系统，用光线步进为点光源、聚光灯和平行光渲染光柱。
creators.why: One of the most starred open volumetric-light implementations; the code is a clear lesson in raymarching participating media.
creators.why_zh: 最受关注的开源体积光实现之一，代码是学习“参与介质光线步进”的清晰教材。

creators.name: Jaagup Kuhi
creators.role_zh: 图形程序员
creators.bio: Estonian programmer who open-sourced a real-time raymarched volumetric cloud renderer for Unity, with weather maps, noise shapes and lighting controls.
creators.bio_zh: 爱沙尼亚程序员，开源了 Unity 实时光线步进体积云渲染器，包含天气图、噪声形状和光照控制。
creators.why: A readable, complete volumetric-cloud implementation that students can study and shrink to an AR-sized cloud.
creators.why_zh: 一个易读且完整的体积云实现，学生可以研究它，并把它缩小成 AR 尺度的一朵云。

creators.name: Alexandre Rivaux (Bonjour Lab)
creators.role: Creative technologist; co-founder of Bonjour Lab
creators.role_zh: 创意技术人、Bonjour Lab 联合创始人
creators.bio: Creative technologist at the Paris studio Bonjour Lab, which builds interactive installations and open-sources Unity tools such as VATUtils for driving Houdini vertex-animation textures from VFX Graph.
creators.bio_zh: 巴黎工作室 Bonjour Lab 的创意技术人，工作室制作互动装置，并开源 Unity 工具，例如用 VFX Graph 驱动 Houdini 顶点动画纹理的 VATUtils。
creators.why: Bridges offline Houdini simulations and real-time VFX Graph, a practical route for heavy effects on AR devices.
creators.why_zh: 把离线的 Houdini 模拟和实时 VFX Graph 连接起来，是在 AR 设备上呈现重型特效的实用路径。

creators.name: Nino Filiu
creators.role: Generative artist, VJ and web developer
creators.role_zh: 生成艺术家、VJ、网页开发者
creators.bio: Paris-based artist, VJ and developer who built Supermosh, the first browser-based datamosh editor, so anyone can glitch video without codecs or command lines.
creators.bio_zh: 常驻巴黎的艺术家、VJ 和开发者，做了第一个浏览器里的数据损坏（datamosh）编辑器 Supermosh，让任何人都能不碰编解码器和命令行就给视频做故障效果。
creators.why: Makes a notoriously technical glitch aesthetic accessible and open, a strong base for camera effects on the web.
creators.why_zh: 把一种出了名门槛高的故障美学变得人人可用且开源，是做网页相机特效的好起点。

creators.name: Xuan Luo
creators.role_zh: 计算机视觉与图形学研究者
creators.bio: Researcher who, as a PhD student at the University of Washington, created Pepper's Cone with Jason Lawrence and Steven Seitz, a DIY 3D display made from a plastic cone and a tablet, with an open Unity implementation.
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，在华盛顿大学读博期间与 Jason Lawrence、Steven Seitz 一起做了 Pepper's Cone：用一个塑料锥和一台平板做成的 DIY 三维显示器，并开源了 Unity 实现。
creators.why: Shows how pre-warping a rendered image turns cheap materials into a convincing floating hologram.
creators.why_zh: 展示了如何通过对渲染图像预先变形，用廉价材料做出以假乱真的悬浮全息影像。

works.title: AR Foundation Post Processing
works.description: The live AR camera view gets cinematic post-processing: depth of field that follows the phone camera's real focus, film grain and motion blur on both the room and the virtual objects.
works.description_zh: 实时的 AR 摄像头画面被加上电影感的后期：景深跟随手机摄像头的真实对焦变化，房间和虚拟物体一起带上胶片颗粒和运动模糊。
works.idea_en: Make virtual objects sit in the camera image by giving them the same lens as the real camera.
works.idea_zh: 给虚拟物体套上和真实摄像头同样的“镜头”，让它们融进画面。
works.technique: A URP post-processing volume runs over the AR Foundation camera background, and a script reads ARKit camera intrinsics each frame to drive the depth-of-field focus distance, grain and motion blur.
works.technique_zh: 在 AR Foundation 的摄像头背景之上叠加 URP 后处理体积，脚本每帧读取 ARKit 的相机内参来驱动景深对焦距离，并加上颗粒和运动模糊。
works.exercise_en: Clone the repo, build it to a phone and place one glossy object on a table; tune depth of field so the object blurs exactly like the real background when you refocus. Twist: animate the grain and color grade to the time of day read from the device clock.
works.exercise_zh: 克隆仓库并构建到手机，在桌面上放一个有光泽的物体；调节景深，让它在重新对焦时和真实背景一样虚化。变体：根据设备时钟的时间动态调整颗粒和调色。

works.title: AR Foundation + VFX Graph
works.description: A glowing VFX Graph particle system floats on a real table, seen through the phone, showing that Unity's GPU particle tool can run on top of the AR camera feed.
works.description_zh: 一团发光的 VFX Graph 粒子漂浮在真实的桌面上，通过手机看到，证明 Unity 的 GPU 粒子工具可以直接运行在 AR 摄像头画面之上。
works.idea_en: Any VFX Graph effect becomes an AR effect once the render pipeline and the camera background agree.
works.idea_zh: 只要渲染管线和摄像头背景配置对了，任何 VFX Graph 特效都能变成 AR 特效。
works.technique: The project configures the Universal Render Pipeline with the AR Foundation background renderer feature, places a slimmed-down Unity Logo VFX Graph on a detected plane, and checks for Metal/Vulkan support at runtime.
works.technique_zh: 工程把 Universal Render Pipeline 与 AR Foundation 的背景渲染特性配置在一起，把精简过的 Unity Logo VFX Graph 放在检测到的平面上，并在运行时检查设备是否支持 Metal/Vulkan。
works.exercise_en: Use the repo as a template: swap the sample graph for your own particle effect and spawn it where the user taps a detected plane. Twist: make the particles collide with the AR plane so they pour off the table edge.
works.exercise_zh: 以这个仓库为模板：把示例图换成你自己的粒子特效，并在用户点击检测到的平面时生成。变体：让粒子与 AR 平面碰撞，从桌子边缘倾泻下去。

works.title: AR Foundation Demos: AR Shaders
works.description: A reel of shaders made for mobile AR: a wireframe over the room's LiDAR mesh, soft blurred shadows that ground objects on real tables, LiDAR depth fog and camera-grain-matched materials. The shaders were written by Arturo Nereu and Landon Townsend; Dan Miller put them into AR.
works.description_zh: 一组为手机 AR 制作的着色器集锦：覆盖在房间 LiDAR 网格上的线框、让物体稳稳落在真实桌面上的柔和模糊阴影、LiDAR 深度雾，以及与摄像头颗粒匹配的材质。着色器由 Arturo Nereu 和 Landon Townsend 编写，Dan Miller 负责把它们放进 AR。
works.idea_en: Shaders that ground and reveal virtual content are what make AR look real, and they can be shared as a library.
works.idea_zh: 让虚拟内容“落地”并显露真实空间的着色器决定了 AR 的真实感，它们可以作为一个库共享。
works.technique: URP Shader Graph shaders with custom HLSL nodes: barycentric vertex colors draw a wireframe on the ARKit mesh, stochastic contact shadows render on transparent planes, the ARKit background shader mixes in scene fog from LiDAR depth, and ARKit's camera-grain texture is applied to virtual materials.
works.technique_zh: 基于 URP Shader Graph 并带自定义 HLSL 节点：用重心坐标顶点色在 ARKit 网格上画线框，在透明平面上渲染随机采样的接触阴影，让 ARKit 背景着色器根据 LiDAR 深度混入场景雾，并把 ARKit 的摄像头颗粒纹理应用到虚拟材质上。
works.exercise_en: Import the AR shaders from arfoundation-demos, show the LiDAR mesh as a wireframe while scanning and ground each placed object with the blurred shadow. Twist: fade the wireframe out wherever the user has already placed content.
works.exercise_zh: 从 arfoundation-demos 导入 AR 着色器，扫描时用线框显示 LiDAR 网格，并用模糊阴影让每个放置的物体落地。变体：在用户已放置内容的地方让线框逐渐消失。

works.title: Record3D → Unity VFX Graph Point Cloud Streaming
works.description: A person filmed by an iPhone X's front depth camera appears in Unity as a live, Kinect-like point cloud, rendered and animated by a VFX Graph.
works.description_zh: iPhone X 前置深度摄像头拍到的人，在 Unity 里实时变成一团类似 Kinect 的点云，由 VFX Graph 渲染并做动画。
works.idea_en: The depth camera already in your pocket can replace a Kinect for live volumetric effects.
works.idea_zh: 口袋里的手机深度摄像头就能替代 Kinect，做实时体积特效。
works.technique: The Record3D app streams RGB and TrueDepth frames over USB; a native plugin in the Unity demo writes them into position and color textures that a VFX Graph samples as a point cache (the graph is one of Keijiro Takahashi's).
works.technique_zh: Record3D 应用通过 USB 传输 RGB 与 TrueDepth 帧；Unity 示例里的原生插件把它们写入位置和颜色纹理，VFX Graph 再把这些纹理当作点缓存来采样（使用的是 Keijiro Takahashi 的 VFX Graph）。
works.exercise_en: Stream yourself from an iPhone into the demo and restyle the point cloud with your own VFX Graph (sparks, dust, ribbons). Twist: bring it back into AR by recording with Record3D, then playing the capture as a floating hologram on a table with AR Foundation.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone 把自己实时传进示例工程，用你自己的 VFX Graph 重新设计点云风格（火花、尘埃、丝带）。变体：用 Record3D 录制，再用 AR Foundation 把录像作为全息影像放回桌面上播放，把它带回 AR。

works.title: Myaku Myaku AR
works.description: Point the phone at a vase of flowers and it turns into a wobbling, glossy red-and-blue blob covered in eyes, the look of the Expo 2025 mascot Myaku-Myaku, while the rest of the room stays real.
works.description_zh: 把手机对准一瓶花，它就会变成一团晃动、带光泽、布满眼睛的红蓝色软体，也就是 2025 大阪世博会吉祥物“脉脉”（Myaku-Myaku）的样子，而房间的其他部分保持真实。
works.idea_en: Segment real objects and re-skin them as a character, so the world itself becomes the costume.
works.idea_zh: 把真实物体分割出来，再给它们换上角色的皮肤，让世界本身变成戏服。
works.technique: A YOLO11 segmentation model runs on-device (likely through his own ONNX Runtime plugin for Unity), and the object masks, likely combined with AR depth, are covered by a noisy, glossy blob shader with eyes.
works.technique_zh: YOLO11 分割模型在设备端运行（很可能通过作者自己的 Unity 版 ONNX Runtime 插件），物体遮罩（很可能结合了 AR 深度）上覆盖一层带噪声和光泽、长着眼睛的软体着色器。
works.exercise_en: Run a segmentation model on the AR camera and replace one object class (cups, plants, chairs) with a material of your choice. Twist: make the material react to the object's label, so every class gets its own creature.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 摄像头画面上运行分割模型，把某一类物体（杯子、植物、椅子）替换成你设计的材质。变体：让材质随物体类别变化，每一类都变成不同的生物。

works.title: World Ensemble
works.description: Walking through a city with a phone, the user taps buildings to place instruments on them and taps the sky to switch the music and visual effects, so the street becomes a playable score.
works.description_zh: 拿着手机在城市里走，点一下建筑就在上面放一件乐器，点一下天空就切换音乐和视觉效果，整条街变成一份可以演奏的乐谱。
works.idea_en: Use the geometry of the city as a sequencer: every building you tag becomes a voice in the song.
works.idea_zh: 把城市的几何形体当成音序器：你标记的每一栋楼都成为歌曲里的一个声部。
works.technique: ARCore Geospatial and Photorealistic 3D Tiles localize the phone and provide building geometry; taps likely raycast against the tiles to anchor instruments, and the visual effects switch with the music (AR Foundation Replay is used to test walks in the editor).
works.technique_zh: ARCore Geospatial 与 Photorealistic 3D Tiles 为手机定位并提供建筑几何；点击时很可能对瓦片模型做射线检测来锚定乐器，视觉效果随音乐切换（作者用 AR Foundation Replay 在编辑器里测试行走录像）。
works.exercise_en: Record an AR Foundation replay of a walk around campus and map three buildings to three loops that start when you look at them. Twist: make the visual effect on each facade follow that building's loop.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里走一圈录制 AR Foundation 回放，把三栋建筑映射成三段循环，看向它们时开始播放。变体：让每面外墙上的视觉效果跟随该建筑的循环节奏。

works.title: MediaPipe FaceMesh on Unity
works.description: A dense face mesh from MediaPipe tracks a person's face in the camera image in real time inside Unity, ready to be textured, lit or distorted.
works.description_zh: MediaPipe 的高密度人脸网格在 Unity 中实时跟踪摄像头画面里的脸，可以直接用来贴图、打光或变形。
works.idea_en: A face filter engine you own: run the face model yourself instead of relying on a platform's lens tools.
works.idea_zh: 一个属于你自己的人脸滤镜引擎：自己运行人脸模型，而不依赖平台的滤镜工具。
works.technique: BlazeFace detects the face and the MediaPipe Face Mesh TensorFlow Lite model regresses 468 landmarks, which the tf-lite-unity-sample project turns into a Unity mesh every frame.
works.technique_zh: BlazeFace 先检测人脸，再用 MediaPipe Face Mesh 的 TensorFlow Lite 模型回归出 468 个关键点，tf-lite-unity-sample 工程每帧把它们转成 Unity 网格。
works.exercise_en: Take the Face Mesh sample and paint the mesh with an animated shader (war paint, glowing veins, a glitch). Twist: detect a mouth-open gesture from the landmarks and emit particles from the lips.
works.exercise_zh: 基于 Face Mesh 示例，给网格加上动态着色器（战纹、发光血管、故障效果）。变体：从关键点判断张嘴动作，让粒子从嘴唇喷出。

works.title: Space Distortion (AR 100 Days, Day 2)
works.description: A patch of the room seen through the phone warps and ripples as if the air itself were bending.
works.description_zh: 手机里看到的一块房间空间发生扭曲和波动，仿佛空气本身在弯曲。
works.idea_en: Bend the camera image locally so reality looks like it has a lens in it.
works.idea_zh: 对摄像头画面做局部扭曲，让现实看起来像被嵌进了一块透镜。
works.technique: Likely a Metal shader that offsets the UV coordinates of the captured ARKit camera image inside a region anchored in the scene, producing a refraction-like distortion.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是 Metal 着色器在场景中锚定的区域内偏移 ARKit 摄像头画面的 UV 坐标，产生类似折射的扭曲。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a sphere in AR and distort only the camera pixels behind it with an animated noise offset. Twist: make the distortion strength follow microphone volume.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中锚定一个球体，只对它背后的摄像头像素施加动态噪声偏移。变体：让扭曲强度跟随麦克风音量。

works.title: Space Voxels (AR 100 Days, Day 20)
works.description: Where the user drags a finger across the screen, cubes appear on the real surfaces, each colored with the camera color of the spot it covers, turning the room into voxels.
works.description_zh: 用户手指在屏幕上划过的地方，真实表面上会长出一个个方块，每个方块都取所覆盖位置的摄像头颜色，把房间变成体素。
works.idea_en: Paint the room into voxels that borrow their color from reality.
works.idea_zh: 把房间画成体素，颜色直接借自现实。
works.technique: Touch points are raycast against the LiDAR scene reconstruction, and a voxel is placed at each hit with its color sampled from the captured camera image at that pixel.
works.technique_zh: 把触摸点对 LiDAR 场景重建做射线检测，在每个命中点放置一个体素，颜色取自该像素处的摄像头图像。
works.exercise_en: Build the voxel brush with AR Foundation meshing on a LiDAR phone and let the class fill a corner of the room together. Twist: snap voxels to a coarse grid so the space turns into a Minecraft version of itself.
works.exercise_zh: 在带 LiDAR 的手机上用 AR Foundation 网格重建实现体素画笔，让全班一起把房间一角填满。变体：把体素吸附到粗网格上，让空间变成它自己的 Minecraft 版本。

works.title: LiDAR Radar (AR 100 Days, Day 21)
works.description: The LiDAR scan of the room is overlaid on the camera view as glowing dots, and a double tap flips to a top-down radar map of everything scanned so far.
works.description_zh: 房间的 LiDAR 扫描结果以发光点的形式叠加在摄像头画面上，双击后切换成俯视的雷达图，显示目前扫描到的一切。
works.idea_en: Show people what the device sees, then let them see it from above.
works.idea_zh: 先让人看到设备“看到”的东西，再让他们从上方俯瞰它。
works.technique: LiDAR depth points are accumulated and drawn with Metal as an overlay in RealityKit, then re-projected into an orthographic top view for the radar mode.
works.technique_zh: 把 LiDAR 深度点累积起来，在 RealityKit 中用 Metal 绘制成叠加层，再重投影成正交俯视图作为雷达模式。
works.exercise_en: Accumulate AR Foundation depth points into a point cloud and render a minimap corner view of the scanned room. Twist: add a sweeping radar line that only reveals points as it passes.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR Foundation 的深度点累积成点云，在屏幕角落渲染已扫描房间的小地图。变体：加一条扫动的雷达线，只在经过时显示点。

works.title: Particle and LiDAR Scan (AR 100 Days, Day 25)
works.description: Particles fall onto a crumpled cloth on a table and slide along its real folds, because they collide with the LiDAR-scanned shape instead of a flat plane.
works.description_zh: 粒子落在桌上一块皱起的布上，沿着布的真实褶皱滑落，因为它们碰撞的是 LiDAR 扫描出的形状，而不是一个平面。
works.idea_en: Once particles can feel real geometry, every object becomes a landscape for them.
works.idea_zh: 一旦粒子能感知真实几何，每个物体都会成为它们的地形。
works.technique: The ARKit scene reconstruction mesh from LiDAR is used as a collision shape for a particle system, so particles bounce and slide along the scanned surfaces.
works.technique_zh: 把 ARKit 通过 LiDAR 得到的场景重建网格作为粒子系统的碰撞体，粒子沿扫描表面反弹和滑动。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation meshing as a VFX Graph or Shuriken collider and pour sand-like particles over objects on a desk. Twist: color each particle by the camera pixel it lands on.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR Foundation 的网格重建作为 VFX Graph 或 Shuriken 的碰撞体，让沙子一样的粒子倾倒在桌上的物体上。变体：用粒子落点处的摄像头像素给它上色。

works.title: Neon Human (AR 100 Days, Day 33)
works.description: People in the camera view are traced with bright neon outlines while the background stays dark, like an animated music-video look applied live.
works.description_zh: 摄像头画面里的人被亮色霓虹轮廓勾勒出来，背景保持暗色，就像实时套用了一段动画音乐录影带的风格。
works.idea_en: Draw light along the edge of the human silhouette to turn anyone into a music-video character.
works.idea_zh: 沿着人体轮廓的边缘画光，让任何人都变成音乐录影带里的角色。
works.technique: ARKit people occlusion (ARMatteGenerator) provides a person matte; a Metal shader likely detects its edges and draws glowing lines over a darkened camera image.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 的人物遮挡（ARMatteGenerator）提供人体遮罩；Metal 着色器很可能检测遮罩边缘，并在调暗的摄像头画面上绘制发光线条。
works.exercise_en: Take the human stencil texture from AR Foundation, run an edge-detect pass and composite neon lines over the camera feed. Twist: animate the line color with the beat of a song.
works.exercise_zh: 从 AR Foundation 获取人体模板纹理，做一次边缘检测，再把霓虹线合成到摄像头画面上。变体：让线条颜色随歌曲节拍变化。

works.title: Fogged Line World (AR 100 Days, Day 35)
works.description: Near the phone the room looks normal, but a few meters away it dissolves into outlines, as if the world were being drawn as a wireframe in the distance.
works.description_zh: 靠近手机的地方房间看起来很正常，但几米之外就溶解成线条，仿佛远处的世界正在被画成线框。
works.idea_en: Use depth as a style switch: reality near, drawing far.
works.idea_zh: 用深度做风格开关：近处是现实，远处是素描。
works.technique: LiDAR scene depth is read per pixel in a shader; beyond a distance threshold the camera image is replaced by an edge-detected line rendering, blended through a fog-like gradient.
works.technique_zh: 在着色器中逐像素读取 LiDAR 场景深度；超过一定距离后，摄像头画面被替换为边缘检测后的线稿，并以类似雾的渐变过渡。
works.exercise_en: Use the AR Foundation environment depth texture to cross-fade between the camera image and a line-art filter at a chosen distance. Twist: let the threshold follow the player so the drawn world closes in over time.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的环境深度纹理，在指定距离处让摄像头画面与线稿滤镜交叉淡化。变体：让阈值随时间逼近玩家，被“画出来”的世界越来越近。

works.title: Pink Smog (AR 100 Days, Day 37)
works.description: A thick pink fog fills the street seen through the phone; objects fade into it with distance, so a car suddenly emerging from the haze feels dangerous.
works.description_zh: 手机里看到的街道被浓厚的粉色雾气填满；物体随距离逐渐隐入雾中，一辆车突然从雾里冲出来时显得十分危险。
works.idea_en: Real depth makes fake weather believable: the fog thickens exactly where the world gets farther away.
works.idea_zh: 真实的深度让虚构的天气变得可信：雾气恰好在世界变远的地方变浓。
works.technique: Per-pixel LiDAR depth drives an exponential fog blend over the camera image in a Metal shader, tinted pink as a homage to a reported pink smog event.
works.technique_zh: 在 Metal 着色器中用逐像素 LiDAR 深度驱动指数雾，与摄像头画面混合，并染成粉色，致敬一次传闻中的粉色雾霾事件。
works.exercise_en: Build depth fog with AR Foundation environment depth and give it a color that tells a story (smoke, pollen, toxic haze). Twist: let the fog clear in a circle around the user's hand.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 环境深度做深度雾，并给它一个讲故事的颜色（烟雾、花粉、毒雾）。变体：让雾在用户手部周围清出一个圆形空洞。

works.title: Real World Splatoon (AR 100 Days, Day 39)
works.description: The user fires paint balls around the room and they splat onto the real walls, furniture and floor, following each surface's shape like the game Splatoon.
works.description_zh: 用户在房间里发射颜料球，它们溅在真实的墙壁、家具和地板上，像游戏 Splatoon 一样贴合每个表面的形状。
works.idea_en: Turn the scanned room into a paintable game surface.
works.idea_zh: 把扫描出的房间变成可以涂色的游戏表面。
works.technique: Projectiles collide with the live LiDAR scene mesh, and paint is likely written onto the reconstructed geometry rebuilt as custom SCNGeometry (which he studied the day before), so the paint wraps around real objects.
works.technique_zh: 弹丸与实时 LiDAR 场景网格碰撞，颜料很可能被写到用自定义 SCNGeometry 重建的几何上（他前一天刚研究过这个），因此颜料能包裹真实物体。
works.exercise_en: Reproduce the effect with AR Foundation meshing and decal projectors: tap to throw a ball, and leave a splat where it hits. Twist: two phones, two colors, and a timer to see who covers more of the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 网格重建和贴花投影器复现这个效果：点击抛出一个球，在命中处留下颜料斑。变体：两部手机、两种颜色，限时比赛谁覆盖的房间面积更大。

works.title: Floor Pit (AR 100 Days, Day 45)
works.description: A section of the real floor cracks into tiles that fall away, opening a pit under the user's feet.
works.description_zh: 一块真实的地板裂成碎片纷纷坠落，在用户脚下打开一个深坑。
works.idea_en: Cut the camera image into pieces and let reality itself fall apart.
works.idea_zh: 把摄像头画面切成碎片，让现实本身塌下去。
works.technique: The floor region of the camera image is likely projected as a texture onto a grid of tiles placed on the detected plane (following a Qiita article he credits); the tiles then fall, revealing a virtual pit beneath.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是把摄像头画面中地板区域的图像作为纹理投影到放在检测平面上的一组瓷砖上（参考了他致谢的一篇 Qiita 文章），再让瓷砖下落，露出下面的虚拟深坑。
works.exercise_en: On a detected floor plane, texture a grid of cubes with the camera image and drop them one by one when the user steps close. Twist: reveal a different world under each tile.
works.exercise_zh: 在检测到的地面平面上，用摄像头画面给一组方块贴图，并在用户靠近时逐个让它们掉落。变体：每块瓷砖下面露出不同的世界。

works.title: Audio Reactive FaceMap (AR 100 Days, Day 52)
works.description: The user's tracked face mesh changes color with the loudness of the sound around them, pulsing with speech and music.
works.description_zh: 用户被跟踪的人脸网格随周围声音的响度改变颜色，随说话和音乐一起脉动。
works.idea_en: Let the face become a VU meter.
works.idea_zh: 让脸变成一个音量表。
works.technique: ARKit face tracking provides the face geometry, and an AudioQueue input measures volume each frame to drive the mesh material color.
works.technique_zh: ARKit 面部跟踪提供人脸几何，AudioQueue 音频输入每帧测量音量，驱动网格材质的颜色。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation face tracking and the microphone to map loudness to a color ramp on the face mesh. Twist: map pitch instead of loudness so singing paints the face.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 面部跟踪和麦克风，把响度映射成人脸网格上的颜色渐变。变体：改为映射音高，让唱歌来给脸上色。

works.title: Passthrough Camera Shaders (QuestCameraKit)
works.description: On Meta Quest 3 the user pinches a slider in the air and a region of the real room seen through passthrough becomes pixelated, one of several camera-image shaders.
works.description_zh: 在 Meta Quest 3 上，用户在空中捏动一个滑块，透视画面中的一块真实房间就变成马赛克，这是几种摄像头画面着色器之一。
works.idea_en: Once the headset camera is readable, the real world can be filtered like a photo, in place.
works.idea_zh: 一旦能读取头显摄像头，现实世界就可以像照片一样被原地加滤镜。
works.technique: The Passthrough Camera API delivers the headset camera image as a texture; the shaders likely reproject it onto world-space quads using the camera pose and intrinsics, then pixelate, blur or recolor it.
works.technique_zh: Passthrough Camera API 以纹理形式提供头显摄像头图像；着色器很可能根据相机位姿和内参把它重投影到世界空间的面片上，再做像素化、模糊或重新调色。
works.exercise_en: Open the camera-shader scene of QuestCameraKit and write a new filter (thermal vision, halftone, edge glow) for a hand-held window. Twist: let two hands define the window's corners.
works.exercise_zh: 打开 QuestCameraKit 的摄像头着色器场景，为一个手持窗口编写新滤镜（热成像、半色调、边缘发光）。变体：用两只手定义窗口的四角。

works.title: MobileNeRF in Unity
works.description: Scenes captured as MobileNeRF neural radiance fields play in Unity as ordinary meshes with a small neural shader, so view-dependent reflections render in real time.
works.description_zh: 以 MobileNeRF 神经辐射场捕捉的场景在 Unity 中以普通网格加一个小型神经着色器的形式播放，视角相关的反射可以实时渲染。
works.idea_en: A neural capture becomes a normal game asset when the network is baked into a shader.
works.idea_zh: 把神经网络烘焙进着色器，神经捕捉就能成为普通的游戏资源。
works.technique: The port imports MobileNeRF's textured polygon meshes and converts the tiny view-dependent MLP into generated shader code, so rasterization plus a per-pixel network evaluation reproduces the radiance field.
works.technique_zh: 移植工程导入 MobileNeRF 的带纹理多边形网格，并把视角相关的小型 MLP 转成自动生成的着色器代码，通过光栅化加逐像素网络计算重现辐射场。
works.exercise_en: Load a MobileNeRF scene in the viewer and place it at tabletop scale in AR Foundation as a miniature diorama. Twist: dissolve between the neural scene and the real table as the user walks around it.
works.exercise_zh: 在查看器中加载一个 MobileNeRF 场景，用 AR Foundation 把它按桌面比例放成微缩景观。变体：用户绕着走时，让神经场景与真实桌面之间互相溶解过渡。

works.title: SNeRG in Unity
works.description: A Sparse Neural Radiance Grid scene is raymarched inside Unity, including in stereo on a PC VR headset, so a captured neural scene can be walked around.
works.description_zh: 一个稀疏神经辐射网格（SNeRG）场景在 Unity 中通过光线步进渲染，也能在 PC VR 头显上以双目方式运行，让人可以在捕捉到的神经场景中走动。
works.idea_en: Raymarch a neural capture like a volume texture and it becomes a place you can stand in.
works.idea_zh: 像渲染体积纹理一样对神经捕捉做光线步进，它就成为一个人可以站在其中的地方。
works.technique: The viewer loads SNeRG's sparse 3D texture atlas and a small deferred MLP; a raymarching shader accumulates density and features, then evaluates the network per pixel, with manual depth testing for single-pass stereo.
works.technique_zh: 查看器加载 SNeRG 的稀疏三维纹理图集和一个小型延迟 MLP；光线步进着色器累积密度和特征，再逐像素计算网络，并为单通道立体渲染做手动深度测试。
works.exercise_en: Place a SNeRG scene inside a portal frame in AR so the neural room is only visible through the doorway. Twist: fade the grid in voxel by voxel as the user approaches.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一个 SNeRG 场景放进传送门框里，只能通过门洞看到这个神经房间。变体：用户靠近时，让网格一块体素一块体素地显现。

works.title: Genesis: 3D Worlds from AI Skyboxes
works.description: A panorama generated from a text prompt is turned into a walkable 3D world in Unity by estimating its depth and extruding the sphere around the viewer.
works.description_zh: 用文字提示生成的全景图在 Unity 中被估计深度并向外挤出球面，变成一个可以走动的三维世界。
works.idea_en: Give a flat AI panorama depth and it becomes a stage set you can step into.
works.idea_zh: 给一张平面的 AI 全景图加上深度，它就成为可以走进去的舞台布景。
works.technique: An equirectangular Skybox Lab panorama is passed through a monocular depth network, and the depth map displaces a sphere mesh so parallax appears when the camera moves.
works.technique_zh: 把 Skybox Lab 生成的等距柱状全景图送入单目深度网络，再用深度图位移一个球面网格，让相机移动时出现视差。
works.exercise_en: Generate a panorama of an imagined place, run it through Genesis and open it as a portal in AR that the user can lean into. Twist: generate two panoramas and blend them by depth.
works.exercise_zh: 生成一个想象地点的全景图，用 Genesis 处理后在 AR 中作为传送门打开，让用户可以探身进去。变体：生成两张全景图并按深度混合。

works.title: Layered Light Field Video on Quest
works.description: Google's immersive light-field videos play on an Oculus Quest in Unity: a waterfall or a dog in a room shows real parallax as the viewer moves their head.
works.description_zh: Google 的沉浸式光场视频在 Unity 中于 Oculus Quest 上播放：观众移动头部时，瀑布或房间里的狗都会呈现真实的视差。
works.idea_en: Volumetric video can be a stack of video-textured shells rather than a point cloud.
works.idea_zh: 体积视频也可以是一层层贴着视频的壳体，而不是点云。
works.technique: The player reads the layered-mesh representation (a set of concentric meshes with per-frame geometry) and maps the decoded video atlas onto them, keeping geometry and video frames in sync.
works.technique_zh: 播放器读取分层网格表示（一组逐帧几何的同心网格），把解码后的视频图集映射上去，并保持几何与视频帧同步。
works.exercise_en: Play one of Google's sample light-field clips in passthrough on a Quest, cropped to a sphere floating in the room. Twist: let the viewer reach in and shrink the sphere to a snow-globe.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Quest 的透视模式下播放一段 Google 光场示例视频，裁成漂浮在房间里的球体。变体：让观众伸手把球缩成一个雪景球。

works.title: Shaderworlds
works.description: Raymarched Shadertoy landscapes such as clouds and entangled vines surround the viewer in a VR headset, opened simply from a web page; the controllers move the sun and vines.
works.description_zh: 云海、缠绕的藤蔓等光线步进的 Shadertoy 景观在 VR 头显中包围观众，只需打开一个网页即可进入；手柄可以移动太阳和藤蔓。
works.idea_en: A fragment shader is already a world; WebXR just lets you stand inside it.
works.idea_zh: 一个片元着色器本身就是一个世界，WebXR 只是让你站进去。
works.technique: three.js renders a raymarching shader per eye, likely rebuilding each ray from the WebXR view and projection matrices so the SDF scene has correct stereo depth; controller poses are passed in as shader uniforms.
works.technique_zh: three.js 为每只眼渲染光线步进着色器，很可能根据 WebXR 的视图和投影矩阵重建每条光线，使 SDF 场景具有正确的立体深度；手柄位姿作为着色器 uniform 传入。
works.exercise_en: Port one Shadertoy SDF scene into the Shaderworlds template and switch the session to immersive-ar so it renders only inside a sphere in the room. Twist: map a hand controller to a parameter of the SDF.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 Shadertoy 的 SDF 场景移植到 Shaderworlds 模板中，并把会话切换为 immersive-ar，让它只在房间中的一个球体内渲染。变体：把手柄映射到 SDF 的某个参数上。

works.title: QuestRoomScan
works.description: Wearing a Meta Quest 3, the user looks around and the room is rebuilt as a colored 3D mesh in real time, then refined and optionally turned into Gaussian splats.
works.description_zh: 戴上 Meta Quest 3 四处看看，房间就被实时重建成一个带颜色的三维网格，随后可以进一步细化，并可选择转换成高斯泼溅。
works.idea_en: The headset can scan the room while you use it, so the real space becomes editable material.
works.idea_zh: 头显在你使用的同时就能扫描房间，让真实空间成为可编辑的材料。
works.technique: Depth API frames are fused into a GPU TSDF volume, Surface Nets extracts a mesh, and passthrough camera images texture it; scans can be sent to a server for Gaussian-splat training and rendered back on device.
works.technique_zh: 把 Depth API 的深度帧融合进 GPU 上的 TSDF 体积，用 Surface Nets 提取网格，再用透视摄像头图像给它贴图；扫描结果可发送到服务器训练高斯泼溅，再回到设备上渲染。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corner of the classroom with QuestRoomScan and apply a shader that makes the scanned mesh melt or ripple while passthrough shows the real room. Twist: freeze a scan, then compare it with the live room to reveal what moved.
works.exercise_zh: 用 QuestRoomScan 扫描教室一角，给扫描网格加一个让它融化或波动的着色器，同时透视画面显示真实房间。变体：冻结一次扫描，再与实时房间对比，找出哪些东西移动过。

works.title: Shader Graph Material Examples for visionOS
works.description: On Apple Vision Pro a model dissolves away along a noisy, glowing edge and reappears, one of a set of open Shader Graph materials that also includes fresnel, caustic waves, flowing rivers and gaseous motion.
works.description_zh: 在 Apple Vision Pro 上，一个模型沿着带噪声的发光边缘溶解消失又重新出现；这是一套开源 Shader Graph 材质之一，其中还包括菲涅耳、焦散波纹、流动的河流和气体流动效果。
works.idea_en: A small library of readable node graphs is the fastest way into shaders on a new platform.
works.idea_zh: 一小套易读的节点图，是进入新平台着色器开发的最快途径。
works.technique: Materials are built in Reality Composer Pro's Shader Graph: a noise texture compared against an animated threshold drives opacity and an emissive edge band, and the material is applied to entities in RealityKit.
works.technique_zh: 材质在 Reality Composer Pro 的 Shader Graph 中搭建：用噪声纹理与动画阈值比较，驱动不透明度和发光边缘带，再把材质应用到 RealityKit 实体上。
works.exercise_en: Rebuild the dissolve material in Reality Composer Pro or Unity Shader Graph and trigger it when a virtual object is placed in the room. Twist: make the dissolve start from the point the user touched.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Reality Composer Pro 或 Unity Shader Graph 中重建溶解材质，当虚拟物体被放进房间时触发。变体：让溶解从用户触碰的位置开始扩散。

works.title: CellularGrowth
works.description: A soft, brain-like mass of cells keeps dividing and pushing against its neighbours until it folds into coral and gut-like shapes.
works.description_zh: 一团柔软、像大脑的细胞不断分裂并推挤邻居，最后折叠成珊瑚和肠道般的形状。
works.idea_en: Let simple push-and-divide rules for thousands of cells grow an organic form on the GPU.
works.idea_zh: 让成千上万个细胞按“推挤+分裂”的简单规则，在 GPU 上长出有机形态。
works.technique: Each cell is a particle in a compute buffer; compute shaders apply repulsion between neighbours, spring forces along edges and divide cells over time, and the result is drawn as instanced spheres or a membrane.
works.technique_zh: 每个细胞是计算缓冲区里的一个粒子；计算着色器计算邻居间的斥力、边上的弹簧力，并随时间让细胞分裂，最后用实例化球体或薄膜渲染出来。
works.exercise_en: Port the growth kernel to AR Foundation and seed the cells where the user taps a real table, so a creature grows out of the surface. Twist: make the growth rate follow the room's light level from the camera.
works.exercise_zh: 把生长内核移植到 AR Foundation，在用户点击真实桌面的位置播种细胞，让一个生物从桌面上长出来。变体：让生长速度跟随相机测到的房间亮度。

works.title: GPUVoxelParticleSystem (unity-voxel)
works.description: A 3D model is broken into glowing voxel cubes that scatter, swirl and snap back together into the original shape.
works.description_zh: 一个三维模型被拆成发光的体素方块，它们飞散、旋转，再拼回原来的形状。
works.idea_en: Turn any mesh into thousands of voxel particles that can leave and return to their home position.
works.idea_zh: 把任意网格变成成千上万个体素粒子，它们可以离开，也能回到原位。
works.technique: The mesh is voxelized on the GPU, each voxel becomes a particle moved by a compute shader (noise and home-position forces), and a geometry shader expands each particle into a cube.
works.technique_zh: 网格在 GPU 上被体素化，每个体素成为一个粒子，由计算着色器驱动（噪声力和回到原位的力），再由几何着色器把每个粒子扩展成立方体。
works.exercise_en: Voxelize a scanned object and place it on a real floor with AR Foundation; when the user walks through it, the voxels scatter around their body and slowly reassemble. Twist: let voxels that fly off stick to the detected room mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个扫描来的物体体素化，用 AR Foundation 放在真实地面上；用户穿过它时体素绕身体散开，再慢慢重新拼合。变体：让飞出的体素粘到检测到的房间网格上。

works.title: GPUVoxelSkinnedMesh (unity-voxel)
works.description: An animated character is re-voxelized every frame, so a running figure made of cubes flickers and shimmers while it moves.
works.description_zh: 一个动画角色每帧都被重新体素化，于是一个由方块组成的奔跑人形一边运动一边闪烁。
works.idea_en: Voxelize a moving, skinned body in real time so motion itself becomes blocky sculpture.
works.idea_zh: 实时体素化一个带骨骼动画的身体，让动作本身变成方块雕塑。
works.technique: Each frame the SkinnedMeshRenderer is baked to a mesh, a compute shader rasterizes its triangles into a voxel grid, and the filled cells are drawn as instanced cubes.
works.technique_zh: 每帧把 SkinnedMeshRenderer 烘焙成网格，用计算着色器把三角形光栅化进体素网格，再把被填充的格子用实例化立方体画出来。
works.exercise_en: Drive the voxelizer with ARKit body tracking so a cube version of the user dances beside them on the phone screen. Twist: freeze the voxels every few seconds to leave a trail of cube statues on the floor.
works.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit 身体追踪驱动体素化，让手机画面里出现一个跟着用户跳舞的方块分身。变体：每隔几秒把体素冻结，在地上留下一串方块雕像。

works.title: unity-volume-rendering
works.description: A medical CT volume floats as a translucent 3D cloud; a slicing plane cuts into it to reveal the inner structure.
works.description_zh: 一组医学 CT 体数据像半透明的三维云一样悬浮，一个切割平面切进去，露出内部结构。
works.idea_en: Raymarch through a 3D texture so volumetric data becomes a glowing object you can slice.
works.idea_zh: 在三维纹理里做光线步进，让体数据变成可以被切开的发光物体。
works.technique: Object-space raymarching steps a ray through a Texture3D inside a cube, accumulates density with a transfer function and clips samples against a user-controlled plane.
works.technique_zh: 在物体空间里对立方体内的 Texture3D 做光线步进，用传递函数累积密度，并用用户控制的平面裁掉部分采样。
works.exercise_en: Place the volume cube on a real table with AR Foundation and use the phone itself as the slicing plane, so moving the phone cuts through the data. Twist: load a volume the class makes from stacked photos of a fruit sliced in real life.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把体数据立方体放在真实桌面上，把手机本身当作切割平面，移动手机就能切开数据。变体：用全班把一只水果真实切片后拍照叠成的体数据来加载。

works.title: unity-teddy
works.description: The user draws a closed outline with the mouse and it instantly inflates into a soft 3D blob that can be rotated.
works.description_zh: 用户用鼠标画一个闭合的轮廓，它立刻膨胀成一个可以旋转的柔软三维团块。
works.idea_en: A 2D doodle becomes a 3D object the moment the stroke closes.
works.idea_zh: 一笔涂鸦在闭合的瞬间就变成三维物体。
works.technique: An implementation of Igarashi's Teddy algorithm: the outline is triangulated with constrained Delaunay, the chordal axis is extracted, and vertices are elevated along it to inflate a closed mesh.
works.technique_zh: 实现了 Igarashi 的 Teddy 算法：先对轮廓做约束 Delaunay 三角剖分，提取弦轴，再沿弦轴抬高顶点，把平面膨胀成封闭网格。
works.exercise_en: Let users trace a shape on the phone screen and spawn the inflated mesh onto a detected AR plane, where it drops with physics. Twist: sample the camera image inside the outline as the blob's texture, so you can 'lift' a drawing off real paper.
works.exercise_zh: 让用户在手机屏幕上描一个形状，把膨胀出的网格生成到检测到的 AR 平面上并让它带物理掉下来。变体：把轮廓内的相机画面采样成团块的贴图，像把真实纸上的画“拎”起来。

works.title: PointCloudExplorer
works.description: A walk through a city block rebuilt from millions of laser-scan points, with points that shimmer, scan and dissolve as the camera moves.
works.description_zh: 在由数百万个激光扫描点重建的街区中穿行，点会随着镜头移动闪烁、扫描和消散。
works.idea_en: Treat a real place scanned as points as a living material, not a finished model.
works.idea_zh: 把扫描得到的真实地点当成一种活的材料，而不是一个完成的模型。
works.technique: Point-cloud data is split into chunks and rendered with a custom point shader; the same code base drove the 'Virtual Hatsudai' app for NTT ICC, with scanlines, transitions and voxelization effects on the points.
works.technique_zh: 点云数据被切成若干块，用自定义点着色器渲染；同一套代码支撑了 NTT ICC 的“ヴァーチュアル初台”应用，并在点上做扫描线、过渡和体素化效果。
works.exercise_en: Scan a corridor with an iPhone LiDAR app, import the points into Unity and replay them in AR aligned to the real corridor, so the scan and the place overlap. Twist: let the points drift away wherever a person is standing.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone 的 LiDAR 扫描应用扫一条走廊，把点云导入 Unity，再在 AR 中与真实走廊对齐回放，让扫描和实地重叠。变体：有人站着的地方，点云就飘散开。

works.title: Rain shader (2D-Unity-Experiments)
works.description: Rain streaks down a window in front of a softly blurred scene; drops gather, slide and leave clear trails in the fogged glass.
works.description_zh: 雨水沿着窗户流下，窗外是柔和模糊的场景；水滴聚集、滑落，在起雾的玻璃上留下清晰的痕迹。
works.idea_en: Make the screen itself feel like wet glass between viewer and world.
works.idea_zh: 让屏幕本身像是隔在观者和世界之间的一块湿玻璃。
works.technique: A full-screen shader (based on a Shadertoy raindrop effect) renders the scene to a RenderTexture, then offsets and blurs its UVs with procedural drop normals so the drops refract the image behind them.
works.technique_zh: 一个全屏着色器（参考 Shadertoy 上的雨滴效果）先把场景渲染到 RenderTexture，再用程序化水滴法线偏移并模糊 UV，让水滴折射后面的画面。
works.exercise_en: Apply the rain shader to the AR camera feed so the real street looks like it is seen through a rainy window. Twist: wipe a clear patch with a finger swipe that slowly fogs up again.
works.exercise_zh: 把雨水着色器用在 AR 相机画面上，让真实街道看起来像是隔着雨窗。变体：手指一划擦出一块清晰区域，然后它慢慢重新起雾。

works.title: Anime-inspired scene (2D-Unity-Experiments)
works.description: A layered anime-style landscape with drifting clouds, glowing sky and parallax, composited live in Unity from flat layers.
works.description_zh: 一个分层的动漫风景：云在飘，天空在发光，前后景有视差，全部由平面图层在 Unity 中实时合成。
works.idea_en: Composite flat illustration layers with shaders until they feel like a living anime background.
works.idea_zh: 用着色器合成平面插画图层，直到它们像一张活的动漫背景。
works.technique: Separate cameras render layers to RenderTextures, and Shader Graph materials combine them with scrolling noise, gradient skies and bloom to animate a static illustration.
works.technique_zh: 多个相机把各图层渲染到 RenderTexture，再用 Shader Graph 材质叠加滚动噪声、渐变天空和泛光，让一张静态插画动起来。
works.exercise_en: Place the layered scene inside an AR portal on a wall so the anime sky moves with parallax as the phone moves. Twist: tint the sky layer with the real sky colour sampled from the camera.
works.exercise_zh: 把分层场景放进墙上的一个 AR 传送门里，手机移动时动漫天空产生视差。变体：用相机采样到的真实天空颜色给动漫天空上色。

works.title: Dynamic hair and petals (2D-Unity-Experiments)
works.description: A 2D character's long hair sways and bounces as she moves while cherry petals fall around her.
works.description_zh: 一个 2D 角色的长发随着动作摇摆弹动，樱花花瓣在她周围飘落。
works.idea_en: Give flat 2D art physical secondary motion with a chain of joints.
works.idea_zh: 用一串关节给平面 2D 美术加上物理的二次运动。
works.technique: Hair strands are rigged with Unity's 2D Animation bones and connected with HingeJoint2D chains so physics drives the bones, while petals are a particle system.
works.technique_zh: 头发用 Unity 2D Animation 的骨骼绑定，再用 HingeJoint2D 链连接，让物理驱动骨骼；花瓣则是一个粒子系统。
works.exercise_en: Stand a 2D paper-doll character on an AR plane and let the phone's motion swing her hair through the joint chain. Twist: blow into the microphone to create wind that lifts the hair and petals.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 2D 纸片人立在 AR 平面上，让手机的运动通过关节链甩动她的头发。变体：对着麦克风吹气产生风，吹起头发和花瓣。

works.title: ARVolumeVFX — Eyez Matrix
works.description: On an iPad, the room captured by LiDAR turns into streams of green particles that trace every wall, chair and surface around the viewer.
works.description_zh: 在 iPad 上，LiDAR 捕捉到的房间变成一串串绿色粒子，勾勒出观者周围的每面墙、每把椅子和每个表面。
works.idea_en: Rebuild the real room out of particles, live, from the device's depth sensor.
works.idea_zh: 用设备的深度传感器，实时用粒子把真实房间重建出来。
works.technique: A LidarDataProcessor reads AR Foundation's environment mesh and depth, and a VFX property binder passes the mesh vertices to VFX Graph, where a subgraph spawns particles on the environment-mesh positions.
works.technique_zh: LidarDataProcessor 读取 AR Foundation 的环境网格和深度，VFX 属性绑定器把网格顶点传给 VFX Graph，由一个子图在环境网格位置上生成粒子。
works.exercise_en: Build the toolkit's example scene on a LiDAR iPhone or iPad and replace the green 'matrix' look with your own particle style. Twist: make particles fall off surfaces like rain whenever the user claps.
works.exercise_zh: 在带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 或 iPad 上构建工具包的示例场景，把绿色“矩阵”外观换成你自己的粒子风格。变体：用户一拍手，粒子就像雨一样从表面上落下。

works.title: ARVolumeVFX — Human particles
works.description: A person in front of the iPad is filled with a cloud of particles that follows their silhouette while the background stays real.
works.description_zh: iPad 前的人被一团粒子填满，粒子跟随他的轮廓移动，而背景保持真实。
works.idea_en: Use the AR human stencil to keep particles only inside a person's body.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 人像遮罩，让粒子只留在人的身体里。
works.technique: Human depth and stencil textures from ARKit people occlusion are bound into VFX Graph; a 'Human Froxel' subgraph places particles in the person's volume and a 'Kill Nonhuman' block removes any particle outside the stencil.
works.technique_zh: 把 ARKit 人物遮挡提供的人体深度和遮罩纹理绑定进 VFX Graph；“Human Froxel”子图把粒子放进人体体积内，“Kill Nonhuman”模块删除遮罩外的所有粒子。
works.exercise_en: Point the phone at a dancer and use the human stencil to turn them into a particle body; record a short clip. Twist: let particles that leave the silhouette keep flying so fast moves shed a trail.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准一位舞者，用人像遮罩把他变成粒子身体并录一段短片。变体：让离开轮廓的粒子继续飞行，快速动作会甩出一条尾迹。

works.title: Unity-ShaderSketches
works.description: A grid of animated patterns — pulsing circles, rotating tiles, interference waves — each drawn by a few lines of ShaderLab code.
works.description_zh: 一格格动画图案——脉动的圆、旋转的瓷砖、干涉波——每一个都只用几行 ShaderLab 代码画出。
works.idea_en: A daily habit of tiny fragment-shader sketches builds a library of moving patterns.
works.idea_zh: 每天写一个很小的片元着色器草图，积累出一整套会动的图案库。
works.technique: Each sketch is a single unlit ShaderLab fragment shader that computes colour from UV, time and math (polar coordinates, fract tiling, smoothstep) with no textures.
works.technique_zh: 每个草图都是一个无光照的 ShaderLab 片元着色器，只用 UV、时间和数学（极坐标、fract 平铺、smoothstep）计算颜色，不用任何贴图。
works.exercise_en: Pick three sketches and apply them as materials on AR planes detected on the floor and walls, so the room is covered in moving patterns. Twist: feed the phone's distance to each surface into the shader so patterns speed up as you approach.
works.exercise_zh: 挑三个草图，作为材质贴到检测到的地面和墙面 AR 平面上，让房间铺满动态图案。变体：把手机到每个表面的距离传进着色器，走近时图案加速。

works.title: Sea of Clouds
works.description: A soft, rolling sea of clouds seen from above, inspired by the cloud kingdom in Super Mario Odyssey, drifting slowly under a bright sky.
works.description_zh: 从上方俯瞰一片柔软翻滚的云海，灵感来自《超级马力欧 奥德赛》的云之国，在明亮天空下缓缓漂移。
works.idea_en: Fake a volumetric cloud sea cheaply with a displaced, soft-shaded surface.
works.idea_zh: 用一个位移并柔化着色的表面，低成本地“假装”出体积云海。
works.technique: A subdivided plane is displaced by scrolling noise in the vertex shader and shaded with soft rim and subsurface-like lighting so it reads as fluffy cloud rather than a hard mesh (likely no raymarching).
works.technique_zh: 一个细分平面在顶点着色器中用滚动噪声做位移，再用柔和的边缘光和类似次表面散射的光照着色，让它看起来是蓬松的云而不是硬网格（很可能没有用光线步进）。
works.exercise_en: Place the cloud sea at knee height across a real room with AR Foundation so visitors wade through it. Twist: push the clouds away wherever the user's feet (tracked floor position of the phone) move.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把云海铺在真实房间膝盖高度，让参观者在云里趟行。变体：用户脚下（手机在地面上的投影位置）经过的地方，云被推开。

works.title: Real-time Water Caustics Simulation
works.description: Rippling light patterns dance on the floor of a pool as the water surface above it moves.
works.description_zh: 水面起伏时，泳池底部跳动着波纹状的光斑。
works.idea_en: Compute where light lands after passing through a moving water surface.
works.idea_zh: 计算光线穿过起伏水面之后落在哪里。
works.technique: Following Yuksel and Keyser's height-field caustics method, rays refracted through the water height field are projected onto the floor and their density is accumulated into a caustics texture each frame.
works.technique_zh: 按照 Yuksel 与 Keyser 的高度场焦散方法，光线经水面高度场折射后投射到地面，每帧把光线密度累积成一张焦散纹理。
works.exercise_en: Project the caustics texture onto a real floor plane in AR with a light that follows the phone, so the room looks like it is under water. Twist: let taps on the screen drop ripples into the simulated surface.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把焦散纹理投到真实地面平面上，光源跟随手机，让房间看起来像在水下。变体：点击屏幕时在模拟水面上激起涟漪。

works.title: Mesh-Based Watercolor Paint
works.description: Brush strokes spread and bleed like wet watercolour pigment, with darker edges and soft overlapping layers.
works.description_zh: 笔触像湿水彩颜料一样扩散、晕开，边缘更深，层层柔和叠加。
works.idea_en: Simulate watercolour as growing, deforming polygons rather than pixels.
works.idea_zh: 用不断生长、变形的多边形而不是像素来模拟水彩。
works.technique: Implements 'Painting with Polygons' (DiVerdi et al.): each stroke is a polygon whose vertices are displaced and subdivided step by step to imitate pigment flow, then composited with edge darkening.
works.technique_zh: 实现了论文 “Painting with Polygons”（DiVerdi 等）：每一笔是一个多边形，顶点被逐步位移和细分来模仿颜料流动，再加上边缘加深合成。
works.exercise_en: Let users paint watercolour strokes on a detected AR wall with a finger and watch them bleed over a minute. Twist: make strokes bleed faster when the phone's microphone hears running water.
works.exercise_zh: 让用户用手指在检测到的 AR 墙面上画水彩笔触，看它们在一分钟里慢慢晕开。变体：手机麦克风听到流水声时晕染加快。

works.title: Smoke Blur Effect
works.description: The rendered scene melts into curling smoke: pixels are dragged along swirling flows so edges wisp away.
works.description_zh: 渲染出的场景融化成翻卷的烟雾：像素被卷曲的流动拖走，边缘化作缕缕青烟。
works.idea_en: Blur an image along a flow field so it looks like it is turning into smoke.
works.idea_zh: 沿着流场模糊画面，让它看起来正在化成烟。
works.technique: A post-processing pass advects the previous frame's colour through a curl-noise velocity field and blends it with the new frame, creating a feedback smoke trail.
works.technique_zh: 一个后期处理 pass 用旋度噪声速度场平流上一帧的颜色，再与新一帧混合，形成反馈式的烟雾拖尾。
works.exercise_en: Apply the smoke blur to the AR camera image masked by people segmentation, so only people dissolve into smoke as they move. Twist: tie the smoke strength to the loudness of the room.
works.exercise_zh: 把烟雾模糊用在 AR 相机画面上，并用人像分割做遮罩，让只有人一动就化成烟。变体：让烟雾强度跟随房间的音量。

works.title: WaterColor Filter
works.description: A 3D scene is re-rendered as a watercolour painting, with wobbling edges, darkened pigment borders and paper texture.
works.description_zh: 一个三维场景被重新渲染成水彩画：边缘微微抖动，颜料边界加深，还有纸张纹理。
works.idea_en: Turn any real-time scene into a moving watercolour illustration.
works.idea_zh: 把任何实时场景变成会动的水彩插画。
works.technique: Tone-based diffuse shading, edge wobbling by noise-offset UVs, edge darkening from colour gradients and a paper-grain overlay are combined in an image-effect chain.
works.technique_zh: 在一条画面特效链中结合了基于色调的漫反射、用噪声偏移 UV 做的边缘抖动、根据颜色梯度的边缘加深和纸纹叠加。
works.exercise_en: Run the filter over the AR camera feed so the real room and the virtual objects share the same watercolour style. Twist: let the paper texture be a photo of real paper the students scan.
works.exercise_zh: 把滤镜用在 AR 相机画面上，让真实房间和虚拟物体呈现同一种水彩风格。变体：把学生扫描的真实纸张照片作为纸纹。

works.title: Star glow shader (Kawase Light Streak)
works.description: Bright highlights in the scene burst into long cross-shaped star streaks, like a camera lens with a star filter.
works.description_zh: 场景里的亮点迸出长长的十字星芒，就像装了星光滤镜的相机镜头。
works.idea_en: Recreate a photographic star filter in real time.
works.idea_zh: 实时再现摄影用的星光滤镜。
works.technique: Following Masaki Kawase's GDC 2003 technique, bright pixels are extracted and blurred repeatedly along a few directions with growing sample offsets, then added back to the image.
works.technique_zh: 按照川濑正树 GDC 2003 的方法，先提取亮像素，再沿几个方向以逐渐增大的采样间距反复模糊，最后叠加回画面。
works.exercise_en: Apply the streak effect to an AR scene so real lamps and virtual objects both flare with star streaks. Twist: rotate the streak directions with the phone's roll angle.
works.exercise_zh: 把星芒效果用在 AR 场景里，让真实灯光和虚拟物体都迸出星芒。变体：让星芒方向跟随手机的横滚角旋转。

works.title: Fluid2D Blur Image Effect
works.description: A GPU fluid simulation smears and swirls the rendered image, so moving the mouse stirs the picture like ink in water.
works.description_zh: 一个 GPU 流体模拟把渲染画面涂抹、搅动，移动鼠标就像在水里搅墨一样搅动画面。
works.idea_en: Use a fluid simulation as a brush that distorts the screen image.
works.idea_zh: 把流体模拟当作画笔，用来扭曲屏幕画面。
works.technique: A 2D Navier-Stokes solver (ported from haxiomic's GPU Fluid Experiments) runs on render textures, and its velocity field offsets and blurs the camera image in a post-processing pass.
works.technique_zh: 一个二维 Navier-Stokes 解算器（移植自 haxiomic 的 GPU Fluid Experiments）在渲染纹理上运行，其速度场在后期处理中偏移并模糊相机画面。
works.exercise_en: Feed the AR camera image into the effect and let finger drags stir the real world like liquid paint. Twist: drive the fluid with optical flow so people walking past stir the image themselves.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR 相机画面送进这个特效，让手指拖动像搅动液体颜料一样搅动真实世界。变体：用光流驱动流体，让路过的人自己搅动画面。

works.title: TouchDesignerPoliceAudioReactive
works.description: An audio-reactive video piece made for the TouchDesigner Advent Calendar 2017 that playfully 'polices' how the name TouchDesigner is written, with graphics pulsing to the music.
works.description_zh: 为 2017 年 TouchDesigner Advent Calendar 制作的声音驱动影像，以玩笑的方式“纠正”大家对 TouchDesigner 名字的写法，画面随音乐律动。
works.idea_en: Make an audio-reactive piece whose subject is a typo everyone makes.
works.idea_zh: 做一个声音驱动的作品，主题是大家都会犯的一个拼写错误。
works.technique: A TouchDesigner network analyses the audio and maps its levels to typography and graphic elements (details in the linked Qiita article); the project file is shared on GitHub.
works.technique_zh: 一个 TouchDesigner 网络分析音频，把音量映射到文字排版和图形元素上（细节见所附 Qiita 文章）；工程文件公开在 GitHub 上。
works.exercise_en: Rebuild the idea in AR: float a word that people often misspell in the room and make its letters jump to music from the phone's microphone. Twist: letters only snap into the correct spelling when the room gets loud.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中重做这个点子：让一个常被拼错的词浮在房间里，字母随手机麦克风收到的音乐跳动。变体：只有房间足够吵时，字母才跳成正确的拼写。

works.title: InkPainter
works.description: The user splashes coloured ink onto 3D objects with the mouse; the paint wraps around curved surfaces and stays on them.
works.description_zh: 用户用鼠标把彩色墨水泼到三维物体上，颜料顺着曲面包裹并留在上面。
works.idea_en: Paint directly onto any mesh at runtime, like spraying ink on real objects.
works.idea_zh: 在运行时直接往任何网格上画，就像往真实物体上喷墨。
works.technique: A raycast hit gives the UV coordinate on the mesh, and a shader blits a brush texture into the object's RenderTexture at that UV, with blending modes and normal/height painting.
works.technique_zh: 射线命中给出网格上的 UV 坐标，着色器把笔刷纹理按该 UV 绘制进物体的 RenderTexture，并支持多种混合模式以及法线、高度绘制。
works.exercise_en: Use AR Foundation meshing so the user can spray virtual ink onto the real room mesh with a tap. Twist: make two phones share the paint so a class can paint the same wall together.
works.exercise_zh: 借助 AR Foundation 的网格重建，让用户点一下就把虚拟墨水喷到真实房间的网格上。变体：让两台手机共享颜料，全班一起涂同一面墙。

works.title: InkPainter with Google Tango
works.description: Holding a Tango phone, the user sprays ink onto a scanned room; the paint lands on real walls and furniture in the camera view.
works.description_zh: 用户拿着 Tango 手机向扫描好的房间喷墨，颜料落在相机画面里的真实墙壁和家具上。
works.idea_en: Graffiti on the real world by painting onto its scanned mesh.
works.idea_zh: 通过在扫描网格上作画，在真实世界里涂鸦。
works.technique: Google Tango's depth sensing reconstructs the room as a mesh; InkPainter paints into that mesh's texture from phone raycasts and the mesh is rendered invisibly except for the paint.
works.technique_zh: Google Tango 的深度感知把房间重建成网格；InkPainter 根据手机射线往这个网格的纹理里作画，网格本身隐形，只显示颜料。
works.exercise_en: Re-create this with AR Foundation meshing on a LiDAR iPhone: hide the room mesh and show only the ink. Twist: let the ink drip down vertical surfaces over time.
works.exercise_zh: 在带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 上用 AR Foundation 网格重建重做：隐藏房间网格，只显示墨水。变体：让墨水随着时间沿竖直表面往下流。

works.title: WaveformProvider
works.description: Objects dropped into a pool send expanding ripples across the water, which interfere and bounce off the edges.
works.description_zh: 掉进水池的物体激起扩散的涟漪，涟漪相互干涉，并在池边反弹。
works.idea_en: Store the water surface as a texture and let a wave equation run on it.
works.idea_zh: 把水面存成一张纹理，让波动方程在上面运行。
works.technique: A shader solves the 2D wave equation on a height RenderTexture each frame; InkPainter writes impulses where objects touch the surface, and the height map drives normals for the water material.
works.technique_zh: 着色器每帧在高度 RenderTexture 上求解二维波动方程；InkPainter 在物体接触水面的位置写入冲击，高度图再驱动水材质的法线。
works.exercise_en: Lay a virtual water surface over a real floor in AR and create ripples wherever the phone's position is projected onto it. Twist: make real objects detected by the camera leave ripples as they move.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把虚拟水面铺在真实地板上，在手机位置投影到水面的地方激起涟漪。变体：让相机检测到的真实物体移动时也留下涟漪。

works.title: WaveShaderDemo (water surface shader)
works.description: A calm water surface in Unity where the cursor leaves trails of ripples that spread and fade across the pond.
works.description_zh: Unity 里一片平静的水面，光标经过的地方留下涟漪，在池面上扩散并渐渐消失。
works.idea_en: A minimal, readable wave simulation that makes any plane react like water.
works.idea_zh: 一个最小且易读的波动模拟，让任何平面都能像水一样反应。
works.technique: Two RenderTextures ping-pong a discrete wave equation in a fragment shader, and the result is sampled as a height/normal map by the surface shader.
works.technique_zh: 两张 RenderTexture 在片元着色器中来回迭代离散波动方程，表面着色器再把结果作为高度/法线贴图采样。
works.exercise_en: Attach the water shader to an AR tabletop and let fingers dragged across the screen draw ripples on the table. Twist: turn the ripples into sound by sampling the height under a virtual microphone point.
works.exercise_zh: 把水面着色器贴到 AR 桌面上，手指在屏幕上划过时在桌面上画出涟漪。变体：在一个虚拟麦克风点下采样高度，把涟漪变成声音。

works.title: IMMATERIA: Forms On Forms
works.description: Shapes made of compute-shader particles grow on the surfaces of other shapes, layering soft forms on forms in a Unity scene.
works.description_zh: 由计算着色器粒子组成的形体，在其他形体的表面上生长，层层叠叠地形成“形上之形”。
works.idea_en: Chain simple compute-shader 'lifeforms' so one simulation lives on the surface of another.
works.idea_zh: 把简单的计算着色器“生命体”串起来，让一个模拟生活在另一个模拟的表面上。
works.technique: IMMATERIA wraps compute buffers ('forms') and kernels ('lifeforms') in reusable Unity components; bindings pass one form's vertices into another's simulation so particles are spawned and constrained on its surface.
works.technique_zh: IMMATERIA 把计算缓冲区（form）和内核（lifeform）封装成可复用的 Unity 组件；通过绑定把一个 form 的顶点传进另一个模拟，让粒子在其表面生成并受其约束。
works.exercise_en: Use the room mesh from AR Foundation as the first 'form' and grow a second particle form over the real furniture. Twist: let the grown form slowly retreat from wherever the phone points.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR Foundation 的房间网格作为第一个 form，在真实家具上长出第二层粒子形体。变体：让长出的形体从手机指向的地方慢慢退开。

works.title: IMMATERIA: My First Gooey Mesh
works.description: A soft mesh wobbles and jiggles like jelly, its vertices pulled back to shape by springs after being disturbed.
works.description_zh: 一个柔软的网格像果冻一样晃动，顶点被扰动后又被弹簧拉回原形。
works.idea_en: Make any mesh gooey by simulating its vertices as springy particles on the GPU.
works.idea_zh: 把网格顶点当作带弹簧的粒子在 GPU 上模拟，让任何网格变得黏糊有弹性。
works.technique: Mesh vertices are copied into a compute buffer, a kernel applies spring forces toward their rest positions plus noise and damping, and the deformed positions are read back in the vertex shader.
works.technique_zh: 网格顶点被复制进计算缓冲区，内核施加朝向静止位置的弹簧力、噪声和阻尼，变形后的位置在顶点着色器中读取。
works.exercise_en: Make a gooey virtual object that sits on a real table in AR and wobbles whenever the user bumps the phone toward it. Twist: let the goo sag and drip over the table edge under gravity.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中做一个放在真实桌面上的黏糊物体，用户把手机朝它“撞”过去时它就晃动。变体：让它在重力作用下下垂，从桌边滴下去。

works.title: URP-PSX
works.description: A modern Unity scene rendered to look like a PlayStation 1 game: wobbling vertices, pixelated textures, reduced colours and fog.
works.description_zh: 一个现代 Unity 场景被渲染成 PlayStation 1 游戏的样子：顶点抖动、纹理像素化、颜色减少、带雾。
works.idea_en: Deliberately degrade rendering to evoke a specific era of graphics.
works.idea_zh: 刻意降低渲染质量，唤起某个时代的图像记忆。
works.technique: Shader Graph materials snap vertex positions to a low-resolution grid in clip space and use affine texture mapping, while URP post effects add colour-depth reduction, dithering and pixelation.
works.technique_zh: Shader Graph 材质在裁剪空间里把顶点吸附到低分辨率网格，并使用仿射纹理映射；URP 后期效果再加上色深降低、抖动和像素化。
works.exercise_en: Render AR objects with the PSX look and apply the same pixelation to the camera feed, so the whole real room looks like a 1996 game level. Twist: let the resolution drop further the farther objects are from the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 用 PSX 风格渲染 AR 物体，并对相机画面做同样的像素化，让整个真实房间看起来像 1996 年的游戏关卡。变体：离手机越远，分辨率降得越低。

works.title: GPU-FlowField
works.description: Hundreds of thousands of particles stream through a 3D flow field, forming swirling ribbons of light.
works.description_zh: 数十万个粒子在三维流场中流动，汇成旋转的光带。
works.idea_en: Let a noise-based vector field steer a huge particle swarm.
works.idea_zh: 让基于噪声的向量场引导一大群粒子。
works.technique: A compute shader fills a 3D grid of direction vectors in URP; each particle reads the nearest grid point every frame to steer its velocity, and the particles are drawn procedurally from a structured buffer.
works.technique_zh: 在 URP 中，计算着色器填充一个三维方向向量网格；每个粒子每帧读取最近的网格点来改变速度，再从结构化缓冲区程序化地绘制粒子。
works.exercise_en: Fill a real room with the flow field in AR and let the phone act as an attractor the particles swirl around. Twist: bend the field around surfaces from the AR room mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让流场充满真实房间，并让手机成为粒子环绕的吸引点。变体：让流场绕开 AR 房间网格中的表面。

works.title: Ghost of Tsushima lanterns (VFX Graph)
works.description: Hundreds of glowing water lanterns bob and drift on a dark surface and part around the player, recreated from the duel scenes of Ghost of Tsushima.
works.description_zh: 数百盏发光的水灯在暗色水面上起伏漂流，并在玩家周围散开，重现了《对马岛之魂》决斗场景中的效果。
works.idea_en: Recreate a memorable game atmosphere entirely on the GPU.
works.idea_zh: 完全在 GPU 上重现一个令人难忘的游戏氛围。
works.technique: A fully commented HDRP VFX Graph spawns lantern meshes as particles on the water plane, animates bobbing and drift with noise, pushes them away from the player position, and a Shader Graph material adds emissive flicker.
works.technique_zh: 一个带完整注释的 HDRP VFX Graph 把灯笼网格作为粒子生成在水面上，用噪声驱动起伏和漂移，并把它们从玩家位置推开；Shader Graph 材质再加上闪烁的自发光。
works.exercise_en: Float the lanterns over a real floor or pond in AR and let them drift away from the viewer's feet. Twist: let each lantern light up when someone speaks near the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中让灯笼漂浮在真实地面或池塘上方，并从观者脚边漂开。变体：有人在手机旁说话时，每盏灯笼逐一亮起。

works.title: HDRP VFX Graph Workshop (VFX-Essentials)
works.description: Grids of particles ripple in sine waves, rings and interference patterns — the first building blocks of a VFX Graph course.
works.description_zh: 一格格粒子按正弦波、圆环和干涉图案起伏——这是一套 VFX Graph 课程的第一批基础模块。
