works.idea_en: Teach VFX Graph by starting from waves: position particles with simple math before anything else.
works.idea_zh: 从“波”开始教 VFX Graph：先用简单的数学摆放粒子，再学其他。
works.technique: Each sample drives particle positions in VFX Graph with sine, distance and time operators on a grid, then layers in noise, SDFs and textures in later sections.
works.technique_zh: 每个示例都在网格上用正弦、距离和时间算子驱动 VFX Graph 中的粒子位置，后面的章节再加入噪声、SDF 和纹理。
works.exercise_en: Rebuild the wave sample with AR Foundation + URP VFX Graph on a phone, laying the wave grid on the floor so it ripples out from the user. Twist: set the wave centre to wherever the user last tapped.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上用 AR Foundation + URP VFX Graph 重做波动示例，把波形网格铺在地上，从用户脚下向外扩散。变体：把波心设为用户最后点击的位置。

works.title: Retro CRT Shader
works.description: A 3D scene seen through an old CRT monitor: curved glass, scanlines, colour bleeding, static noise and rolling distortion.
works.description_zh: 透过一台老式 CRT 显示器看三维场景：弯曲的玻璃、扫描线、串色、雪花噪点和滚动的失真。
works.idea_en: Turn a clean render into a warm, flickering memory of old screens.
works.idea_zh: 把干净的渲染变成一段温暖、闪烁的老屏幕记忆。
works.technique: A Shader Graph applied to a camera RenderTexture warps UVs with a barrel distortion, multiplies scanline and RGB-mask patterns, and adds noise-driven static and vertical roll.
works.technique_zh: 一个用于相机 RenderTexture 的 Shader Graph，用桶形畸变扭曲 UV，乘上扫描线和 RGB 掩膜图案，再加入噪声驱动的雪花和垂直滚动。
works.exercise_en: Map the CRT shader onto a virtual TV placed in the room with AR, showing the live camera feed from the phone's other lens. Twist: increase the static the farther the viewer stands from the TV.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把 CRT 着色器贴到一台放在房间里的虚拟电视上，屏幕里播放手机另一颗镜头的实时画面。变体：观者离电视越远，雪花越多。

works.title: Grass Geometry Shader (URP)
works.description: A field of grass blades sways in the wind, generated entirely on the GPU from a flat mesh.
works.description_zh: 一片草叶在风中摇摆，全部由 GPU 从一个平面网格生成。
works.idea_en: Grow a whole meadow from a plane by letting the GPU emit the blades.
works.idea_zh: 让 GPU 自己吐出草叶，从一个平面长出一整片草地。
works.technique: A hand-written URP geometry shader emits a few triangles per vertex as a blade, randomises height and bend per blade, and bends them with a scrolling wind texture (based on Roystan's tutorial).
works.technique_zh: 一个手写的 URP 几何着色器为每个顶点生成几个三角形作为草叶，随机化每片草的高度和弯曲，并用滚动的风纹理让它们摆动（基于 Roystan 的教程）。
works.exercise_en: Grow the grass on a detected AR floor plane and push the blades away from the phone's projected position so walking parts the grass. Twist: make the grass grow only where the camera sees green.
works.exercise_zh: 在检测到的 AR 地面上长草，并把草叶从手机的投影位置推开，走过时草会分开。变体：只在相机看到绿色的地方长草。

works.title: CurveModifier
works.description: A mesh slides along a 3D curve and bends to follow it, like a train or a snake following a path drawn in space.
works.description_zh: 一个网格沿着三维曲线滑动并随之弯曲，就像火车或蛇沿着空中画出的路径前进。
works.idea_en: Bend any mesh along a path, as Blender's curve modifier does, but live in the engine.
works.idea_zh: 像 Blender 的曲线修改器那样，把任意网格沿路径弯曲，但在引擎中实时进行。
works.technique: The curve is baked into a texture of positions and tangents, and a vertex shader looks up each vertex's position along the curve to rebuild it in the curve's local frame.
works.technique_zh: 曲线被烘焙成一张存储位置和切线的纹理，顶点着色器根据每个顶点在曲线上的位置去查表，并在曲线的局部坐标系里重建顶点。
works.exercise_en: Let users draw a path through the room in AR by moving the phone, then send a long mesh creature crawling along it. Twist: have the creature's body stretch when the path passes through a doorway.
works.exercise_zh: 让用户在 AR 中移动手机画出一条穿过房间的路径，再让一只长条网格生物沿着它爬行。变体：路径穿过门口时，生物的身体被拉长。

works.title: godot-particles
works.description: Thousands of GPU particles swirl in curl-noise currents and gather toward targets, rendered as small shaded spheres; shared as a template for the Godot engine.
works.description_zh: 成千上万个 GPU 粒子在旋度噪声的气流中旋转，并向目标聚拢，以带明暗的小球渲染；作为 Godot 引擎的模板分享出来。
works.idea_en: A minimal GPU-particle template for an open-source engine.
works.idea_zh: 为开源引擎准备的一个最小 GPU 粒子模板。
works.technique: A Godot particles shader (shader_type particles) updates each particle with curl-noise, collision and 'go to' force-field rules, and a billboard shader draws every particle as a sphere impostor.
works.technique_zh: 一个 Godot 粒子着色器（shader_type particles）按旋度噪声、碰撞和“趋向目标”的力场规则更新每个粒子，再用公告板着色器把每个粒子画成球体替身（impostor）。
works.exercise_en: Port the template to a WebXR or Godot OpenXR passthrough scene and emit particles from the controllers or hands. Twist: freeze all particles in place when the user closes a fist.
works.exercise_zh: 把模板移植到 WebXR 或 Godot OpenXR 的透视场景中，从手柄或双手发射粒子。变体：用户握拳时所有粒子原地冻结。

works.title: ZIGSIM-Parallax (PC as a portal)
works.description: A desktop monitor turns into a window onto a 3D space: as the viewer moves their head, the scene behind the screen shifts in correct perspective.
works.description_zh: 一台桌面显示器变成通往三维空间的窗口：观者移动头部时，屏幕后方的场景按正确透视随之变化。
works.idea_en: Track the viewer's head with a phone and render off-axis perspective so a flat screen feels like a hole in the wall.
works.idea_zh: 用手机追踪观者的头部，渲染离轴透视，让一块平面屏幕感觉像墙上的一个洞。
works.technique: The ZIG SIM Pro app streams face-tracking data from an iPhone over OSC (received with OscJack); a CameraController moves the Unity camera to the head position and a Mapper shader projects the rendered RenderTexture onto the screen plane (off-axis projection, likely).
works.technique_zh: ZIG SIM Pro 应用通过 OSC 从 iPhone 发送面部追踪数据（用 OscJack 接收）；CameraController 把 Unity 相机移到头部位置，Mapper 着色器再把渲染出的 RenderTexture 投到屏幕平面上（很可能是离轴投影）。
works.exercise_en: Use ARKit face tracking on the front camera of a phone to drive the same off-axis camera, so the phone screen becomes a portal into a room behind it. Twist: place the portal on a real wall with the back camera and let two viewers see it from their own positions.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机前置摄像头的 ARKit 面部追踪驱动同样的离轴相机，让手机屏幕变成通往后方房间的传送门。变体：用后置摄像头把传送门放在真实墙面上，让两个观者各自从自己的位置观看。

works.title: 3D Reaction Diffusion (Marching Cubes)
works.description: A glossy, coral-like blob keeps growing and reshaping itself as two simulated chemicals react inside a 3D volume.
works.description_zh: 一个光滑、像珊瑚的团块在不断生长、改变形状：两种模拟化学物质在三维体积里相互反应。
works.idea_en: Run reaction-diffusion in 3D and turn the chemical field into a living surface.
works.idea_zh: 在三维空间里运行反应扩散，把化学浓度场变成一个活的表面。
works.technique: A compute shader iterates the Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion equations on a 3D grid, and a GPU Marching Cubes pass extracts an isosurface of one chemical's concentration each frame.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器在三维网格上迭代 Gray-Scott 反应扩散方程，每帧再用 GPU Marching Cubes 提取其中一种化学物质浓度的等值面。
works.exercise_en: Grow the reaction-diffusion volume on a real table with AR Foundation, seeded where the user taps. Twist: add chemical wherever the phone is held close, so the form grows toward the viewer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在真实桌面上培养反应扩散体，用户点击处作为种子。变体：手机靠近的地方加入化学物质，让形体朝观者生长。

works.title: Counter-Strike 2 Smoke Grenades
works.description: A smoke grenade fills a room with volumetric smoke that flows around walls, and gunshots and explosions punch holes that slowly close again.
works.description_zh: 一颗烟雾弹让体积烟充满房间，烟会绕着墙流动；枪弹和爆炸会在烟里打出洞，再慢慢合拢。
works.idea_en: Smoke that knows the room: it floods the free space and can be pushed away.
works.idea_zh: 懂得房间形状的烟：它填满空处，也能被推开。
works.technique: The level is voxelised, a compute shader flood-fills smoke through free voxels from the grenade, and the smoke is ray-marched with noise and lighting while bullet capsules carve temporary holes in the density.
works.technique_zh: 先把关卡体素化，计算着色器从烟雾弹位置沿空体素做洪水填充，再用噪声和光照对烟雾密度做光线步进渲染；子弹轨迹的胶囊体会在密度里暂时挖出空洞。
works.exercise_en: Voxelise a real room from the AR Foundation LiDAR mesh on an iPhone Pro and flood-fill the repo's smoke from a point the user taps, so it pours around real furniture. Twist: let a hand swipe (tracked by the camera) blow a hole through the cloud.
works.exercise_zh: 用 iPhone Pro 上 AR Foundation 的 LiDAR 网格把真实房间体素化，从用户点击的位置用仓库里的方法洪水填充烟雾，让烟绕着真实家具流动。变体：用摄像头追踪的手势挥动，把烟云打出一个洞。

works.title: Pixel Sorting
works.description: Bright spans of each frame melt into long streaks as pixels are sorted by brightness in real time, turning a 3D scene into moving glitch art.
works.description_zh: 每一帧里的亮部被按亮度排序，拉成长长的条纹，把三维场景变成流动的故障艺术。
works.idea_en: A classic still-image glitch, made fast enough to run on live video.
works.idea_zh: 把经典的静态图像故障效果，做到能在实时画面上运行。
works.technique: A compute shader masks pixels by a luminance threshold, finds contiguous spans per row or column, and sorts each span on the GPU before compositing it back over the frame.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器先按亮度阈值选出像素，在每行或每列里找出连续片段，再在 GPU 上对每段排序，最后合成回画面。
works.exercise_en: Run the pixel-sort pass on the passthrough camera image of a phone AR app (AR Foundation camera background + a URP renderer feature) so the real street streaks when the user taps. Twist: sort only pixels inside the people-segmentation mask.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 应用的摄像头画面上（AR Foundation 摄像头背景 + URP 渲染器特性）运行像素排序，让用户点击时真实街景被拉成条纹。变体：只对人像分割蒙版内的像素排序。

works.title: Simulating the Entire Ocean
works.description: An endless ocean surface rolls under a moving camera, with foam, reflections and subsurface colour, built up from simple sine waves to an FFT spectrum.
works.description_zh: 镜头下是无边的海面，带着泡沫、反射和次表面颜色；效果从简单的正弦波一步步做到 FFT 频谱海洋。
works.idea_en: Real oceans are sums of thousands of waves, and the GPU can add them up every frame.
works.idea_zh: 真实海洋是成千上万个波的叠加，GPU 每帧都能把它们算出来。
works.technique: A JONSWAP wave spectrum is evolved in frequency space and inverse-FFT'd in compute shaders into displacement and normal maps, which a physically based water shader renders with foam from the Jacobian.
works.technique_zh: 在频域里演化 JONSWAP 海浪谱，用计算着色器做逆 FFT 得到位移和法线贴图，再由基于物理的水体着色器渲染，并用雅可比行列式生成泡沫。
works.exercise_en: Place a small patch of the repo's FFT ocean inside a floor portal in AR (AR Foundation plane + stencil mask) so the room floor opens onto a sea. Twist: drive wind speed from the phone microphone level.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 里把仓库的 FFT 海洋放进地面上的一个传送门（AR Foundation 平面 + 模板遮罩），让房间地板打开一片海。变体：用手机麦克风音量控制风速。

works.title: Shell Texturing Fur
works.description: Grass-like fur grows out of simple meshes and sways, made of many stacked transparent shells instead of individual hair geometry.
works.description_zh: 简单网格上长出像草一样的毛发并随风摆动；它不是一根根毛的几何体，而是许多层叠的半透明外壳。
works.idea_en: Stack enough thin slices and a flat surface becomes fuzzy volume.
works.idea_zh: 叠够多的薄层，平面就变成毛茸茸的体积。
works.technique: The mesh is drawn N times, each shell pushed out along the normal; a hashed noise texture decides per-strand height, and shells discard pixels above that height, with displacement for gravity and wind.
works.technique_zh: 把网格绘制 N 次，每一层沿法线向外推；用哈希噪声纹理决定每根毛的高度，高于该高度的像素被丢弃，再加上重力和风的位移。
works.exercise_en: Apply the shell-fur shader to a real object scanned with the phone (Object Capture or LiDAR mesh) and place it back in AR, so a real mug becomes furry. Twist: make the fur flatten where the user touches the screen.
works.exercise_zh: 把毛发外壳着色器用到手机扫描的真实物体上（Object Capture 或 LiDAR 网格），再放回 AR 场景，让一只真实的杯子长毛。变体：手指在屏幕上按到的地方，毛被压平。

works.title: Kuwahara Filter
works.description: A 3D game scene turns into a moving oil painting as the Kuwahara filter smooths flat areas into brush-like patches while keeping edges sharp.
works.description_zh: 三维游戏场景变成一幅会动的油画：Kuwahara 滤镜把平坦区域抹成笔触般的色块，同时保留清晰边缘。
works.idea_en: Pick the calmest neighbourhood around every pixel and the image paints itself.
works.idea_zh: 每个像素都取周围最“平静”的一块区域，画面就自己变成了油画。
works.technique: A post-processing shader compares the variance of several sectors around each pixel and outputs the mean of the least varied one; the anisotropic version orients the sectors along the local structure tensor.
works.technique_zh: 后处理着色器比较每个像素周围若干扇区的方差，输出方差最小扇区的平均色；各向异性版本会让扇区沿局部结构张量的方向排列。
works.exercise_en: Port the anisotropic Kuwahara pass to a URP renderer feature and apply it to the AR camera feed, so the real room becomes a painting while virtual objects stay crisp. Twist: blend from photo to painting as the user walks closer.
works.exercise_zh: 把各向异性 Kuwahara 移植成 URP 渲染器特性，应用到 AR 摄像头画面上，让真实房间变成油画而虚拟物体保持清晰。变体：用户越走近，画面越从照片过渡到油画。

works.title: Color Quantization and Dithering
works.description: A 3D scene is reduced to a handful of colours and ordered-dither patterns, giving it the look of an old handheld console or a printed zine.
works.description_zh: 三维场景被压缩到少数几种颜色和有序抖动图案，看起来像老掌机画面或印刷小册子。
works.idea_en: Fewer colours plus a clever pattern read as a strong style instead of a loss.
works.idea_zh: 更少的颜色加上巧妙的图案，读起来是鲜明的风格，而不是损失。
works.technique: A post-processing pass downsamples the frame, adds a Bayer-matrix threshold offset per pixel, quantizes each channel to a few levels and optionally maps the result to a palette before upscaling with point sampling.
works.technique_zh: 后处理先对画面降采样，给每个像素加上 Bayer 矩阵阈值偏移，把每个通道量化到少数几级，可选地映射到调色板，再用点采样放大。
works.exercise_en: Apply the dithering pass to the phone's AR camera background so the world looks like a Game Boy screen, keeping virtual sprites in the same palette. Twist: switch palettes by pointing the camera at different colour cards.
works.exercise_zh: 把抖动效果应用到手机 AR 的摄像头背景上，让世界看起来像 Game Boy 屏幕，虚拟精灵也用同一调色板。变体：把镜头对准不同颜色的卡片来切换调色板。

works.title: Rendering Millions of Particles
works.description: Tens of millions of particles trace glowing 3D fractal attractors that morph smoothly from one shape to another, lit with a brute-force ambient occlusion pass.
works.description_zh: 数千万个粒子勾勒出发光的三维分形吸引子，并在不同形状之间平滑变形，再用暴力环境光遮蔽来照明。
works.idea_en: Apply a few random affine maps over and over and a fractal appears out of points.
works.idea_zh: 反复套用几个随机仿射变换，分形就从一堆点里浮现出来。
works.technique: A compute shader runs the chaos game of an iterated function system for every particle each frame, interpolating the affine transforms between two systems, and draws the points with procedural instancing plus an occlusion estimate.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器每帧为每个粒子运行迭代函数系统的“混沌游戏”，并在两个系统的仿射变换之间插值，再用程序化实例绘制这些点，并估算遮蔽。
works.exercise_en: Anchor a fractal cloud from the repo on a tracked image in AR and let the phone's distance to the marker morph between two attractors. Twist: seed the affine maps from the user's hand-pose landmarks.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把仓库里的分形点云锚定在一张识别图上，用手机到识别图的距离在两个吸引子之间变形。变体：用手部姿态关键点来生成仿射变换。

works.title: How Games Render So Much Grass
works.description: Fields of millions of grass blades sway in the wind, built step by step from billboards and geometry shaders to GPU-instanced blades culled on the GPU.
works.description_zh: 数百万根草叶在风里摆动；效果从公告板、几何着色器一步步做到 GPU 实例化并在 GPU 上剔除的草叶。
works.idea_en: A meadow is one blade drawn a million times with small differences.
works.idea_zh: 一片草地，就是一根草画一百万次，每次略有不同。
works.technique: A compute shader scatters blade positions over a terrain, frustum-culls them into an append buffer, and DrawMeshInstancedIndirect renders them with vertex-shader wind from scrolling noise.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器在地形上撒布草叶位置，做视锥剔除后写入追加缓冲区，再用 DrawMeshInstancedIndirect 渲染，顶点着色器用滚动噪声模拟风。
works.exercise_en: Grow the repo's instanced grass on detected AR floor planes (AR Foundation) so a carpet of grass appears in the living room. Twist: bend the blades away from the phone's position as the user walks through.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 检测到的地面平面上生长仓库里的实例化草地，让客厅铺满草。变体：用户走过时，草叶朝远离手机的方向弯倒。

works.title: 3D Physarum Transport Networks
works.description: Millions of agents crawl through a 3D volume, leaving trails that they then follow, so glowing vein-like networks grow and reorganise on their own.
works.description_zh: 数百万个智能体在三维空间里爬行、留下痕迹又追随痕迹，发光的叶脉状网络自己生长并不断重组。
works.idea_en: Slime-mould logic in 3D: simple agents following their own trails build networks.
works.idea_zh: 三维的黏菌逻辑：追随自己痕迹的简单个体，编织出网络。
works.technique: Following Jeff Jones's Physarum model, compute shaders move agents that sense a 3D trail texture ahead of them, turn toward the strongest trail, deposit into it, and the trail volume is diffused and decayed each frame before volume rendering.
works.technique_zh: 按照 Jeff Jones 的多头绒泡菌模型，计算着色器让每个智能体感知前方三维痕迹纹理、转向最强的痕迹并沉积；痕迹体积每帧扩散和衰减，然后做体渲染。
works.exercise_en: Seed the Physarum agents from a LiDAR point cloud of a real room in AR so glowing networks grow along the furniture edges. Twist: let the user place food sources by tapping, and watch the network reroute.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中用真实房间的 LiDAR 点云作为黏菌智能体的起点，让发光的网络沿家具边缘生长。变体：用户点击放置“食物”，观察网络如何改道。

works.title: Lights of Nibel
works.description: A short real-time film inspired by the Ori games: spirits of light drift through a dark forest, stirring glowing fluid that swirls and fades behind them.
works.description_zh: 一部受《Ori》系列启发的实时短片：光之精灵在黑暗森林中飘动，搅起在身后旋转、消散的发光流体。
works.idea_en: Light as a liquid that creatures stir as they pass.
works.idea_zh: 把光当作液体，生灵经过时会把它搅动。
works.technique: Chimera, his 2D fluid framework, solves a fast vorticity-confined fluid in a custom render texture; emitters inject velocity and colour, and the velocity field advects dye and VFX Graph particles.
works.technique_zh: 他的二维流体框架 Chimera 在自定义渲染纹理里求解带涡度约束的快速流体；发射器注入速度和颜色，速度场再平流染料和 VFX Graph 粒子。
works.exercise_en: Map Chimera's fluid texture onto a detected AR wall and let virtual fireflies (VFX Graph particles) stir it, then let the user's finger become another emitter. Twist: use the room's real light level to set how bright the fluid glows.
works.exercise_zh: 把 Chimera 的流体纹理贴到 AR 检测到的墙面上，让虚拟萤火虫（VFX Graph 粒子）搅动它，再把用户的手指变成另一个发射器。变体：用房间的真实亮度决定流体的发光强度。

works.title: Chimera: Particle Advection
works.description: VFX Graph particles are carried along by a live 2D fluid simulation, curling into vortices wherever the fluid is stirred.
works.description_zh: VFX Graph 粒子被实时二维流体带着走，在流体被搅动的地方卷成漩涡。
works.idea_en: Let a fluid, not a noise function, decide where particles go.
works.idea_zh: 让流体而不是噪声函数，决定粒子往哪里去。
works.technique: The fluid's velocity is stored in the R and G channels of a render texture, which VFX Graph samples each frame to set particle velocity.
works.technique_zh: 流体速度存放在渲染纹理的 R、G 通道里，VFX Graph 每帧采样这张纹理来设置粒子速度。
works.exercise_en: Lay the fluid texture over an AR table top and emit particles from a tracked real object as it slides across. Twist: make the particles sample the fluid only inside the camera's people-occlusion mask.
works.exercise_zh: 把流体纹理铺在 AR 桌面上，让一个被追踪的真实物体滑过时发射粒子。变体：粒子只在摄像头的人物遮挡蒙版内采样流体。

works.title: Coriolis
works.description: A real-time journey through different scales of time and space, where Physarum networks and fluid currents form nebula-like structures that grow and dissolve.
works.description_zh: 一段穿越不同时空尺度的实时旅程：黏菌网络与流体洋流形成星云般的结构，不断生长又消散。
works.idea_en: The same growth rule reads as cells, rivers or galaxies depending on the scale.
works.idea_zh: 同一条生长规则，换一个尺度，看上去就是细胞、河流或星系。
works.technique: His Physarum and fluid simulation frameworks run together in Unity: agent trails form the structure while the fluid field advects and distorts them.
works.technique_zh: 他的黏菌与流体模拟框架在 Unity 中同时运行：智能体痕迹形成结构，流体场再平流并扭曲这些结构。
works.exercise_en: Place a Physarum-plus-fluid volume above a table in AR and let the phone's zoom (distance to the volume) change the simulation scale. Twist: freeze the growth when the user holds still, so the piece rewards patience.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把黏菌 + 流体的体积放在桌面上方，用手机与体积的距离改变模拟尺度。变体：用户保持不动时生长才会凝固，让作品奖励耐心。

works.title: Eulerian Fluid Simulator
works.description: Smoke-like streams flow around an obstacle the user drags through a wind tunnel, shedding vortices, in a grid fluid simulator written from scratch in Unity.
works.description_zh: 用户在风洞里拖动一个障碍物，烟雾般的流线绕过它并甩出涡旋；这是在 Unity 里从零写的网格流体模拟。
works.idea_en: A fluid is just a grid of velocities kept divergence-free.
works.idea_zh: 流体不过是一张保持无散度的速度网格。
works.technique: A staggered-grid Eulerian solver (after Matthias Müller's Ten Minute Physics) applies Gauss-Seidel projection for incompressibility and semi-Lagrangian advection of velocity and smoke, all in C#.
works.technique_zh: 一个交错网格欧拉解算器（改编自 Matthias Müller 的 Ten Minute Physics），用 Gauss-Seidel 投影保证不可压缩，并对速度和烟雾做半拉格朗日平流，全部用 C# 实现。
works.exercise_en: Port the solver to a compute shader and project it onto an AR floor plane, using the tracked phone position as the moving obstacle so walking leaves a wake. Twist: add real walls from the LiDAR mesh as solid cells.
works.exercise_zh: 把解算器移植到计算着色器，投射到 AR 地面平面上，用追踪到的手机位置当作移动障碍物，让走动留下尾流。变体：把 LiDAR 网格中的真实墙面作为固体格子加入。

works.title: Death Star Ray Marching Shader
works.description: A Death Star floats in space, rendered not from a mesh but by a shader that marches rays into a signed distance field of a sphere with a carved dish.
works.description_zh: 一颗死星悬浮在太空中；它不是网格，而是着色器沿光线步进一个“挖去碟形凹坑的球体”距离场渲染出来的。
works.idea_en: Two spheres and a subtraction make an iconic shape without a single polygon.
works.idea_zh: 两个球加一次相减，不用一个多边形就能做出标志性的形状。
works.technique: A fragment shader on a cube ray-marches a signed distance field built from a sphere minus a smaller sphere, computes normals from the SDF gradient and shades the result.
works.technique_zh: 在一个立方体上的片元着色器对“大球减小球”的距离场做光线步进，用距离场梯度求法线再着色。
works.exercise_en: Put the ray-marched SDF inside a cube anchored in AR so it looks like a solid object hovering in the room, then add a second SDF that blends with it smoothly. Twist: let the user carve the shape by tapping to subtract spheres.
works.exercise_zh: 把光线步进的距离场放进一个锚定在 AR 里的立方体，让它看起来像悬浮在房间里的实体，再加入第二个距离场与之平滑融合。变体：用户点击就减去一个球，亲手雕刻形状。

works.title: Parallax Occlusion Mapping Hole
works.description: A deep, mysterious hole appears in a flat ground plane and stays convincing as the camera moves, although the surface is a single flat quad.
works.description_zh: 平坦的地面上出现一个又深又神秘的洞，镜头移动时依然逼真，而这个表面其实只是一块平面。
works.idea_en: A flat surface can fake depth by shifting its texture with the view angle.
works.idea_zh: 平面也能伪造深度：让纹理随视角偏移。
works.technique: Parallax occlusion mapping steps along the view ray through a height map in the fragment shader and offsets the texture coordinates to where the ray hits, faking a deep cavity.
works.technique_zh: 视差遮挡映射在片元着色器里沿视线穿过高度图步进，把纹理坐标偏移到光线命中的位置，从而伪造出深坑。
works.exercise_en: Place the hole shader on an AR floor plane so a pit opens in the real floor and holds up as the user walks around it. Twist: animate the height map so something climbs out.
works.exercise_zh: 把这个洞的着色器放到 AR 地面平面上，让真实地板裂开一个坑，用户绕着走也不穿帮。变体：让高度图动起来，仿佛有东西从里面爬出来。

works.title: Tornado Simulator
works.description: A twister sweeps across a small town, sucking up cars, cows and debris and flinging them around its funnel.
works.description_zh: 一股龙卷风扫过小镇，把汽车、奶牛和碎片吸进去，再沿漏斗甩出来。
works.idea_en: A tornado is a few forces: pull in, lift up, spin around.
works.idea_zh: 龙卷风就是几种力：向内吸、向上抬、绕圈转。
works.technique: Rigidbodies inside the funnel get a radial pull toward the axis, an upward lift and a tangential force, while particle systems draw the funnel and dust.
works.technique_zh: 漏斗内的刚体受到指向轴心的径向拉力、向上的升力和切向力，粒子系统负责画出漏斗和尘土。
works.exercise_en: Drop a miniature tornado onto an AR table top and let it pick up virtual objects the user has placed there. Twist: make it suck up a real object's scanned copy from the LiDAR mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个迷你龙卷风放到 AR 桌面上，让它卷起用户放置的虚拟物体。变体：让它把 LiDAR 扫描出的真实物体副本也卷走。

works.title: GPU Fluid 3D
works.description: Coloured smoke swirls inside a 3D volume as a compute-shader fluid solver runs and a moving source keeps injecting density and force.
works.description_zh: 彩色烟雾在三维体积里翻卷：计算着色器运行流体解算，一个移动的源不断注入密度和力。
works.idea_en: A GPU fluid needs only a few kernels: advect, project, repeat.
works.idea_zh: GPU 流体只需要几个内核：平流、投影、重复。
works.technique: The MinimalCompute 01_4_Fluid_3D scene extends the GPU Gems stable-fluids solver to 3D render textures (advection, divergence, Jacobi pressure, projection) and ray-marches the density.
works.technique_zh: MinimalCompute 的 01_4_Fluid_3D 场景把 GPU Gems 的稳定流体解算扩展到三维渲染纹理（平流、散度、Jacobi 压力、投影），再对密度做光线步进。
works.exercise_en: Put the 3D fluid box in AR around a real object and inject smoke from the phone's position so the user can blow smoke at it. Twist: use the microphone to control injection strength.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把三维流体盒子罩在一个真实物体周围，从手机位置注入烟雾，让用户朝它“吹烟”。变体：用麦克风音量控制注入强度。

works.title: Sparkle Reflection Effect
works.description: Tiny star-shaped glints pop up only on the brightest highlights of the image, like light catching on glitter or wet surfaces.
works.description_zh: 只在画面最亮的高光处冒出小小的星形闪光，就像光落在亮片或湿润表面上。
works.idea_en: Let the image itself decide where the sparkles go.
works.idea_zh: 让画面自己决定闪光出现在哪里。
works.technique: A compute shader scans the frame for pixels above a brightness threshold, appends them to a buffer, and draws star sprites there with an indirect draw call, so no data returns to the CPU.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器扫描画面里亮度超过阈值的像素，把它们追加到缓冲区，再用间接绘制在这些位置画星形精灵，数据不必回到 CPU。
works.exercise_en: Run the sparkle pass on the AR camera image so real highlights (windows, jewellery, water) twinkle on the phone. Twist: tint each sparkle with the colour sampled from the pixel underneath.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 摄像头画面上运行闪光效果，让真实的高光（窗户、首饰、水面）在手机里闪烁。变体：用下方像素的颜色给每个闪光着色。

works.title: VFX Graph as Mesh Deformer
works.description: A mesh ripples and deforms as if it were liquid, because each of its vertices is driven by a VFX Graph particle.
works.description_zh: 一个网格像液体一样起伏变形，因为它的每个顶点都由一个 VFX Graph 粒子驱动。
works.idea_en: Treat every vertex as a particle and all of VFX Graph's forces become mesh deformers.
works.idea_zh: 把每个顶点当成粒子，VFX Graph 的所有力都变成了网格变形器。
works.technique: VFX Graph writes particle positions into a GraphicsBuffer indexed like the mesh's vertices, and a shader reads that buffer to displace the mesh.
works.technique_zh: VFX Graph 把粒子位置写进一个按网格顶点索引排列的 GraphicsBuffer，着色器读取它来位移网格。
works.exercise_en: Use the trick on the AR face mesh (ARKit face tracking) so a turbulence field makes the user's face melt and reform. Twist: attract the vertices toward the user's hand position.
works.exercise_zh: 把这个技巧用到 AR 人脸网格上（ARKit 面部追踪），让湍流场使用户的脸融化又复原。变体：让顶点被吸向用户手的位置。

works.title: Drawing with Epicycles (DFT)
works.description: Chains of spinning circles redraw a picture line by line, each circle rotating at its own frequency, and the tip paints into a texture on the GPU.
works.description_zh: 一串旋转的圆一笔一笔重画出一幅图，每个圆以自己的频率旋转，末端在 GPU 上的纹理里作画。
works.idea_en: Any drawing can be rebuilt from rotating circles.
works.idea_zh: 任何一幅画都能用旋转的圆重新画出来。
works.technique: A discrete Fourier transform turns a traced path into circle frequencies and phases; the epicycle tip positions go through a StructuredBuffer to a compute shader that paints them into a render texture.
works.technique_zh: 离散傅里叶变换把描出的路径转成各个圆的频率和相位；本轮末端位置通过 StructuredBuffer 送进计算着色器，画进渲染纹理。
works.exercise_en: Let users trace a shape in the air with the phone in AR, then replay it as spinning epicycles hovering where it was drawn. Twist: drop the highest frequencies so the drawing becomes smoother and more abstract.
works.exercise_zh: 让用户在 AR 里用手机在空中描一个形状，然后在原位用旋转的本轮重放它。变体：去掉高频项，让图形变得更平滑、更抽象。

works.title: Physarum with Vector Fields
works.description: Slime-mould agents spread their glowing trails across the screen, but an embedded vector field bends their paths into swirling, combed patterns.
works.description_zh: 黏菌智能体在屏幕上铺开发光的痕迹，而嵌入的矢量场把它们的路径弯成旋转、梳理过一般的图案。
works.idea_en: Add one outside force to an emergent system and it starts drawing with intent.
works.idea_zh: 给一个涌现系统加上一股外力，它就开始有意图地作画。
works.technique: A Unity compute shader implements Jeff Jones's Physarum model (sense, rotate, move, deposit, diffuse, decay); the vector-field variant adds a flow term to each agent's heading (the variant is likely an extension of the published repo).
works.technique_zh: Unity 计算着色器实现了 Jeff Jones 的黏菌模型（感知、转向、移动、沉积、扩散、衰减）；矢量场版本在每个智能体的朝向上加了一项流场分量（这个变体很可能是在公开仓库基础上的扩展）。
works.exercise_en: Run the Physarum simulation on a texture laid over an AR floor and derive the vector field from the phone's movement, so walking combs the slime. Twist: use the room's LiDAR depth edges as walls the agents cannot cross.
works.exercise_zh: 把黏菌模拟跑在铺在 AR 地面上的纹理里，并用手机的移动生成矢量场，让走动去“梳理”黏菌。变体：把房间 LiDAR 深度的边缘当作智能体无法穿越的墙。

works.title: Dithered Hand as Physarum Stimulus
works.description: A dithered image of a hand is fed to a Physarum simulation, and the agents gather along its dots until a living, vein-like hand emerges (Genuary 2022, day 2).
works.description_zh: 把一张抖动处理过的手部图像喂给黏菌模拟，智能体沿着点阵聚集，直到浮现出一只像叶脉一样活着的手（Genuary 2022 第 2 天）。
works.idea_en: An image becomes food: the slime draws a picture by eating it.
works.idea_zh: 图像变成了食物：黏菌靠“吃”它把画面画了出来。
works.technique: The dithered hand texture is added to the trail map as a constant attractant, so agents that sense the trail concentrate on the image's dark dots (likely built on the published Physarum repo).
works.technique_zh: 抖动后的手部纹理作为恒定的吸引物加进痕迹图里，感知痕迹的智能体就会聚集到图像的暗点上（很可能基于公开的黏菌仓库）。
works.exercise_en: Feed the live people-segmentation mask from AR Foundation (or a hand mask from MediaPipe) into the Physarum trail map so slime grows over the user's real hand on screen. Twist: make the mask repel instead of attract, so the slime flees the body.
works.exercise_zh: 把 AR Foundation 的实时人像分割蒙版（或 MediaPipe 的手部蒙版）送进黏菌痕迹图，让黏菌在屏幕上爬满用户真实的手。变体：让蒙版改为排斥，黏菌就会逃离身体。

works.title: MeshToSDF
works.description: Particles swarm over and cling to an animated character as its mesh is converted into a signed distance field every frame and fed to Unity's VFX Graph.
works.description_zh: 粒子成群地附着在一个动画角色身上：角色网格每帧都被转换成有向距离场，再送进 Unity 的 VFX Graph。
works.idea_en: If a moving body becomes a distance field, particles can feel its surface.
works.idea_zh: 把运动的身体变成距离场，粒子就能“摸到”它的表面。
works.technique: A compute shader rasterises the mesh triangles into a 3D texture and runs a jump-flooding pass to fill it with distances, which VFX Graph's Conform to SDF and Collide with SDF blocks read in real time.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器把网格三角形光栅化进三维纹理，再用跳跃洪泛（jump flooding）填充距离值，VFX Graph 的 Conform to SDF 和 Collide with SDF 模块实时读取它。
works.exercise_en: Convert the ARKit body-tracking skeleton's skinned mesh (or the face mesh) to an SDF every frame and let VFX Graph particles cling to the user in AR. Twist: switch the particles from clinging to fleeing when the user claps.
works.exercise_zh: 每帧把 ARKit 人体追踪驱动的蒙皮网格（或人脸网格）转换成距离场，让 VFX Graph 粒子在 AR 中附着在用户身上。变体：用户拍手时，粒子从附着变成逃离。

works.title: Poseidon
works.description: A photoreal open ocean with breaking crests, foam and golden-hour light runs entirely in the browser.
works.description_zh: 一片带着破碎浪尖、泡沫和黄昏光线的逼真海洋，完全在浏览器里运行。
works.idea_en: A film-grade ocean technique, now a web page.
works.idea_zh: 电影级的海洋技术，如今只是一张网页。
works.technique: Three cascades of Tessendorf inverse FFT run as WebGPU compute shaders (three.js TSL) to produce displacement and normals, shaded with measured water optics, subsurface scattering and foam.
works.technique_zh: 三级 Tessendorf 逆 FFT 以 WebGPU 计算着色器（three.js TSL）运行，生成位移和法线，再用实测的水体光学参数、次表面散射和泡沫着色。
works.exercise_en: Put a small patch of Poseidon inside a WebXR hit-test portal on the floor so the phone shows a sea below the room. Twist: sync the sun direction to the real time of day.
works.exercise_zh: 把一小块 Poseidon 海洋放进 WebXR 命中测试得到的地面传送门里，让手机里房间下面出现一片海。变体：让太阳方向与现实中的时间同步。

works.title: Tiamat
works.description: Tens of thousands of water particles slosh inside the browser window, and on a phone the water follows the device's tilt through the gyroscope.
works.description_zh: 数万个水粒子在浏览器窗口里晃荡；在手机上，水会通过陀螺仪跟着设备的倾斜流动。
works.idea_en: Tilt the phone and the water inside it moves like water in a glass.
works.idea_zh: 倾斜手机，里面的水就像杯中水一样流动。
works.technique: An SPH (smoothed-particle hydrodynamics) solver runs 20k–100k particles in WebGPU compute shaders with the gravity vector taken from the device orientation, and the surface is ray-marched.
works.technique_zh: SPH（光滑粒子流体动力学）解算在 WebGPU 计算着色器里运行 2 万至 10 万个粒子，重力方向取自设备姿态，水面用光线步进渲染。
works.exercise_en: Pour Tiamat's fluid into a virtual glass anchored on a real table in WebXR and feed the phone's motion into the solver, so the water sloshes as the user walks around the glass. Twist: let the user tap to drop objects that splash.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 里把 Tiamat 的流体倒进一只锚定在真实桌面上的虚拟杯子，并把手机的运动传给解算器，用户绕着杯子走动时水会晃动。变体：点击屏幕投下会溅起水花的物体。

works.title: Dryad
works.description: Procedural trees grow from a seed in the browser, with every leaf rendered as its own card so whole canopies move volumetrically in the wind.
works.description_zh: 程序化的树从一个种子在浏览器里长出来，每片叶子都是单独的面片，整个树冠会在风中立体地摆动。
works.idea_en: A seed number is enough to grow a unique tree, down to each leaf.
works.idea_zh: 一个种子数就足以长出一棵独一无二的树，细到每一片叶子。
works.technique: Branches are generated by rules seeded from a number (and, per the repo, planet physics), and leaves are drawn as GPU-instanced cards animated by wind in three.js / WebGPU.
works.technique_zh: 枝干由一个种子数驱动的规则生成（仓库说明还结合了星球物理），叶子以 GPU 实例化面片绘制，并在 three.js / WebGPU 中随风摆动。
works.exercise_en: Grow a Dryad tree from a WebXR hit-test point on the floor, using the date or the user's name as the seed so everyone plants a different tree. Twist: let the tree grow a little each time the user returns to the same spot.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 命中测试得到的地面位置长出一棵 Dryad 树，用日期或用户名字作为种子，让每个人种出不同的树。变体：用户每次回到同一地点，树都会再长大一点。

works.title: The Magic Revealing Flashlight Shader
works.description: A hidden message on a wall stays invisible until a flashlight beam sweeps over it; only the lit cone shows the secret texture.
works.description_zh: 墙上的隐藏信息平时看不见，只有手电筒光束扫过时，被照亮的光锥里才显出秘密纹理。
works.idea_en: Light itself becomes the key that reveals hidden content.
works.idea_zh: 光本身就是揭开隐藏内容的钥匙。
works.technique: The shader receives the spotlight's position, direction and cone angle as uniforms and, per pixel, outputs the hidden texture's alpha only where the surface point lies inside the cone.
works.technique_zh: 着色器把聚光灯的位置、方向和锥角作为参数传入，逐像素判断表面点是否落在光锥内，只有在锥内才输出隐藏纹理的透明度。
works.exercise_en: Place an AR Foundation plane on a real wall, attach the reveal shader, and drive the spotlight from the phone camera's pose so the phone acts as a torch that uncovers hidden writing. Twist: hide a different message for each of two phones so players must combine their beams.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在真实墙面上放一个平面并挂上显形着色器，用手机相机的位姿驱动聚光灯，让手机变成照出隐藏文字的手电筒。变体：给两台手机各藏一段信息，玩家必须把光束合在一起才能读全。

works.title: Energy Shield Shader
works.description: A translucent sci-fi force field flares with expanding ripples wherever projectiles hit it.
works.description_zh: 一个半透明的科幻力场，被投射物击中的位置会亮起并向外扩散波纹。
works.idea_en: Every impact leaves a ripple on an invisible barrier.
works.idea_zh: 每一次撞击都在无形的屏障上留下涟漪。
works.technique: A C# script sends an array of recent hit positions and times to the shader, which adds a fading ring around each hit on top of a fresnel rim glow.
works.technique_zh: C# 脚本把最近的撞击位置和时间作为数组传给着色器，着色器在菲涅尔边缘光之上，为每个撞击点叠加一个逐渐消退的光环。
works.exercise_en: Wrap a person or a real chair in an AR shield dome using AR Foundation body or plane anchors, and send a hit to the shader wherever the user taps the screen. Twist: let microphone claps trigger random impacts.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 的人体或平面锚点把一个人或一把真实的椅子罩进 AR 护盾里，用户点屏幕的位置就向着色器发送一次撞击。变体：让麦克风听到拍手时触发随机撞击。

works.title: Night Vision Camera Effect
works.description: A dark scene is re-lit as a grainy green night-vision image, inspired by the camcorder in Outlast, where nearby surfaces glow brightest.
works.description_zh: 受《逃生》里摄像机的启发，漆黑的场景被重新照亮成带颗粒感的绿色夜视画面，离镜头越近的表面越亮。
works.idea_en: Depth becomes light: what is close to the camera is what you can see.
works.idea_zh: 深度就是光：离镜头近的东西才看得见。
works.technique: An image effect combines the depth texture with scene albedo so brightness falls off with distance, then tints the result green and adds animated noise and a vignette.
works.technique_zh: 画面特效把深度纹理和场景反照率结合起来，让亮度随距离衰减，再染成绿色并叠加动态噪点和暗角。
works.exercise_en: Rebuild the effect on the AR camera feed, using the LiDAR environment depth from AR Foundation's occlusion manager as the depth input so the real room turns into night vision. Twist: add virtual creatures that are only visible in the night-vision mode.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 相机画面上重做这个效果，把 AR Foundation 遮挡管理器提供的 LiDAR 环境深度当作深度输入，让真实房间变成夜视画面。变体：加入只有在夜视模式下才看得见的虚拟生物。

works.title: Conway's Game of Life with Compute Shaders
works.description: Conway's Game of Life runs entirely on the GPU, with cells blinking, gliding and dying across a large texture in real time.
works.description_zh: 康威生命游戏完全在 GPU 上运行，细胞在一张大纹理上实时闪烁、滑行和消亡。
works.idea_en: Four simple rules on a grid generate endless living patterns.
works.idea_zh: 网格上的四条简单规则，就能生成无穷无尽的“生命”图案。
works.technique: A compute shader reads the previous state texture, counts the eight neighbours of every cell and writes the next generation into a second render texture, swapping the two each frame.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器读取上一帧的状态纹理，统计每个细胞的八个邻居，把下一代写进第二张渲染纹理，每帧交换两张纹理。
works.exercise_en: Map the Game of Life texture onto a detected AR floor plane and let the user seed live cells by tapping or walking over the floor. Twist: seed cells from the camera image so real objects become starting patterns.
works.exercise_zh: 把生命游戏纹理贴到 AR 检测出的地面平面上，让用户点击或走过地面来播下活细胞。变体：用相机画面来播种，让真实物体成为初始图案。

works.title: Contour Map Shader
works.description: A terrain is drawn as a cartographic map, with evenly spaced contour lines tracing its height.
works.description_zh: 一片地形被画成地图的样子，等间距的等高线勾勒出它的高度。
works.idea_en: Any surface can be read as a map by slicing it at regular heights.
works.idea_zh: 按固定高度切片，任何表面都能读成一张地图。
works.technique: The shader samples a heightmap, takes the fractional part of height divided by the line spacing, and draws a thin line where it crosses zero, using screen-space derivatives to keep line width constant.
works.technique_zh: 着色器采样高度图，用高度除以线距取小数部分，在它归零处画一条细线，并用屏幕空间导数保持线宽一致。
works.exercise_en: Apply the contour shader to the LiDAR scene mesh from AR Foundation meshing, using world height instead of a heightmap, so the whole room is overlaid with topographic lines. Twist: animate the line spacing so a flood level rises through the room.
works.exercise_zh: 把等高线着色器用在 AR Foundation 网格重建得到的 LiDAR 场景网格上，用世界坐标高度代替高度图，让整个房间覆盖上地形等高线。变体：让等高线动起来，像水位一样在房间里慢慢上涨。

works.title: Pencil Effect
works.description: A rendered 3D scene is redrawn in real time as a hand-sketched pencil drawing with hatching strokes and paper grain.
works.description_zh: 渲染出的三维场景被实时重画成手绘铅笔素描，带有排线笔触和纸张纹理。
works.idea_en: Turn any live image into a moving sketchbook page.
works.idea_zh: 把任何实时画面变成会动的素描本。
works.technique: A single full-screen pixel shader detects edges in the source image and layers hash-based noise strokes whose density follows luminance, likely with a scale factor to control stroke size.
works.technique_zh: 一个全屏像素着色器检测源图像的边缘，并叠加基于哈希噪声的笔触，笔触密度随亮度变化，很可能用一个缩放系数控制笔触大小。
works.exercise_en: Run the pencil shader as a post effect on the passthrough camera image of an AR Foundation app so the real world looks hand-drawn while virtual objects stay colored. Twist: fade from sketch to photo wherever the user points the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 把铅笔着色器作为后期处理加在 AR Foundation 应用的相机画面上，让真实世界看起来像手绘，而虚拟物体保持彩色。变体：手机指向的地方从素描渐变回照片。

works.title: ShaderToy to Unity: Fluid Dynamics
works.description: Colourful fluid swirls endlessly across a texture as Florian Berger's ShaderToy fluid runs inside Unity.
works.description_zh: Florian Berger 的 ShaderToy 流体在 Unity 里运行，彩色流体在纹理上不停地旋转翻涌。
works.idea_en: A self-feeding texture is enough to make convincing, never-repeating fluid.
works.idea_zh: 一张不断把自己喂回去的纹理，就足以做出逼真且永不重复的流体。
works.technique: A compute shader reads the previous frame's texture, advects colour along a rotational velocity field, and writes to a second render texture; the two buffers swap every frame to accumulate the flow.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器读取上一帧的纹理，沿旋转速度场平流颜色，写进第二张渲染纹理；两个缓冲每帧交换，让流动不断累积。
works.exercise_en: Put the fluid texture on an AR plane under a real object and inject colour at the object's position each frame so it seems to stir paint on the table. Twist: use the phone's motion as the stirring force.
works.exercise_zh: 把流体纹理放在真实物体下方的 AR 平面上，每帧在物体位置注入颜色，看起来像它在桌上搅动颜料。变体：用手机的移动作为搅动的力。

works.title: See-Through Objects Shader
works.description: Parts of an object turn see-through according to a mask, revealing what is behind, with optional desaturation and grain filters on the visible surface.
works.description_zh: 物体的一部分按照遮罩变得透明，露出后面的东西，可见的表面还可以选择去色或加颗粒滤镜。
works.idea_en: A mask decides where a solid object stops being solid.
works.idea_zh: 一张遮罩决定实体在哪里不再是实体。
works.technique: An unlit shader samples a colour map and a mask texture and discards or blends pixels where the mask is dark, with keyword variants for desaturation and grain.
works.technique_zh: 一个无光照着色器采样颜色贴图和遮罩纹理，在遮罩暗的地方丢弃或混合像素，并用关键字变体实现去色和颗粒效果。
works.exercise_en: Build an AR x-ray: cover a real wall with an occlusion plane that uses a mask from the phone's touch point, so the user 'cuts' holes to see virtual pipes behind the wall. Twist: make the hole follow the user's gaze on a headset.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 透视：用遮挡平面覆盖真实墙面，遮罩来自手机的触摸点，让用户“切开”墙面看到后面的虚拟管道。变体：在头显上让洞口跟随用户的视线。

works.title: ShaderToy to Unity: Particle Collision
works.description: Thousands of particles move and collide with one another in real time, ported from a ShaderToy sketch into Unity.
works.description_zh: 成千上万个粒子实时运动并相互碰撞，由一个 ShaderToy 草图移植到 Unity。
works.idea_en: Particle physics can live entirely in a GPU buffer.
works.idea_zh: 粒子物理可以完全放在 GPU 缓冲里运行。
works.technique: A compute shader stores each particle's position and velocity in a structured buffer, integrates motion with the frame delta and resolves collisions, then a shader draws the buffer as points.
works.technique_zh: 计算着色器把每个粒子的位置和速度存在结构化缓冲里，按帧间隔积分运动并处理碰撞，然后由着色器把缓冲绘制成点。
works.exercise_en: Spawn the particle buffer above a detected AR table plane and use the plane height as the collision floor so particles pile up on the real table. Twist: use the LiDAR mesh so particles also bounce off real objects.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 检测到的桌面平面上方生成粒子，用平面高度作为碰撞地面，让粒子堆积在真实桌上。变体：改用 LiDAR 网格，让粒子也能从真实物体上弹开。

works.title: Crystal Caustics
works.description: A rotating crystal throws sharp, sparkling caustic light patterns onto the surfaces around it in real time.
works.description_zh: 一颗旋转的水晶在周围表面上实时投下锐利、闪烁的焦散光斑。
works.idea_en: Bake the expensive physics once, then replay it cheaply as light.
works.idea_zh: 把昂贵的物理计算只做一次，之后用光来低成本地重放。
works.technique: Caustics are pre-rendered with photon mapping into cubemaps for a set of light directions around a bounding icosahedron, and at runtime the point-light cookie blends the nearest cubemaps using barycentric weights of the light direction.
works.technique_zh: 先用光子映射为包围二十面体周围的一组光照方向预渲染焦散立方体贴图，运行时根据光线方向的重心坐标权重，在点光源 cookie 中混合最近的几张贴图。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual gem on a real table with AR Foundation and project its caustic cookie onto the detected plane, using the AR light estimation direction as the light. Twist: let the user rotate the gem with a pinch so the caustics dance.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把一颗虚拟宝石放到真实桌面上，以 AR 光照估计的方向作为光源，把焦散 cookie 投射到检测到的平面上。变体：让用户用双指旋转宝石，让焦散光斑跳动起来。

works.title: Mixed Reality Theater
works.description: During a live theater performance, audience members wearing AR glasses see virtual stage effects appear around the actors, triggered by the director.
works.description_zh: 现场戏剧演出中，观众戴着 AR 眼镜，看到导演触发的虚拟舞台特效出现在演员周围。
works.idea_en: Stage effects no longer need to be physical: every seat sees them through AR glasses.
works.idea_zh: 舞台特效不必再是实体的：每个座位都能透过 AR 眼镜看到它们。
works.technique: All headsets calibrate to a shared origin by scanning one tracked image, the director places effects that are stored as anchors on a server, and the server broadcasts cues so every device plays the effect at the same place and time.
works.technique_zh: 所有头显通过扫描同一张追踪图片校准到共同原点，导演摆放的特效以锚点形式存到服务器上，演出时服务器广播提示，让每台设备在同一位置、同一时刻播放特效。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-phone AR scene with image-target calibration and trigger a particle burst on both devices from a laptop cue. Twist: tie the cue to the stage lighting desk or a music beat.
works.exercise_zh: 用图像标记校准做一个双手机 AR 场景，并从笔记本电脑发送提示，同时在两台设备上触发粒子爆发。变体：把提示连到舞台灯光控台或音乐节拍上。

works.title: Screen-Space Outlines
works.description: A stylised 3D scene gains crisp, even ink outlines around objects and creases, and the devlog walks through how they are detected.
works.description_zh: 一个风格化三维场景的物体轮廓和折痕上出现了清晰均匀的墨线，开发日志讲解了这些线是如何检测出来的。
works.idea_en: Edges found in depth and normals turn any render into an illustration.
works.idea_zh: 从深度和法线中找到的边缘，能把任何渲染画面变成插画。
works.technique: A URP renderer feature renders view-space normals and depth, then a full-screen pass runs Roberts-cross style edge detection on both and composites dark lines where the differences exceed thresholds.
works.technique_zh: 一个 URP 渲染功能先渲染视空间法线和深度，再用全屏 pass 对两者做 Roberts 交叉式的边缘检测，差异超过阈值的地方叠加深色线条。
works.exercise_en: Apply the outline renderer feature to virtual objects in an AR Foundation scene and also feed LiDAR depth so real furniture gets inked too, making the room look like a comic panel. Twist: vary line thickness with distance to the user.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR Foundation 场景里给虚拟物体加上描边渲染功能，同时输入 LiDAR 深度，让真实家具也被描线，整个房间像一格漫画。变体：让线条粗细随与用户的距离变化。

works.title: Cel Shading (Devlog 3)
works.description: Characters and props switch from smooth lighting to flat bands of light and shadow with sharp specular highlights, supporting several lights and cast shadows.
works.description_zh: 角色和道具从平滑光照变成扁平的明暗色带和锐利高光，并支持多个光源和投射阴影。
works.idea_en: Quantise light into a few bands and a 3D model reads like hand-painted animation.
works.idea_zh: 把光照量化成几个色阶，三维模型就像手绘动画。
works.technique: A custom URP lit shader computes diffuse, specular and rim terms per light and passes them through smoothstep thresholds, while sampling URP's shadow maps for the main and additional lights.
works.technique_zh: 自定义的 URP 光照着色器为每个光源计算漫反射、高光和边缘光，再用 smoothstep 阈值把它们分成色阶，同时采样 URP 的主光源和附加光源阴影贴图。
works.exercise_en: Use the cel shader on AR characters and drive the main light from AR Foundation light estimation so the toon shadows match the real room. Twist: add a slider that lets viewers change the number of light bands live.
works.exercise_zh: 把卡通着色器用在 AR 角色上，并用 AR Foundation 的光照估计驱动主光源，让卡通阴影和真实房间一致。变体：加一个滑块，让观众实时改变明暗色阶的数量。

works.title: Uber Stylized Water
works.description: A stylised cartoon water surface with depth colour, foam along shorelines and animated waves, shown in a short sneak peek before release.
works.description_zh: 一片风格化卡通水面，带有随深度变化的颜色、岸边泡沫和动画波浪，这是发布前的简短预览。
works.idea_en: Depth-based colour and foam make any shoreline read as water.
works.idea_zh: 基于深度的颜色和泡沫，让任何岸线一看就是水。
works.technique: The URP water shader compares scene depth with the water surface depth to blend shallow and deep colours and draw intersection foam, likely combined with vertex waves and scrolling normal maps.
works.technique_zh: URP 水面着色器比较场景深度和水面深度，混合浅水色和深水色并画出交界处的泡沫，很可能还结合了顶点波浪和滚动的法线贴图。
works.exercise_en: Place the water plane slightly above a real floor with AR Foundation and use LiDAR depth so foam appears where the water meets real feet and furniture. Twist: raise the water level slowly to flood the room.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把水面放在真实地面稍上方，并用 LiDAR 深度，让泡沫出现在水面与真实的脚和家具相交处。变体：慢慢升高水位，让房间被淹没。

works.title: SdfManipulator
works.description: In the Unity editor, smooth SDF shapes are dragged, blended and carved with gizmos while the raymarched result updates live.
works.description_zh: 在 Unity 编辑器里，用操作手柄拖动、融合和雕刻平滑的 SDF 形体，光线步进的结果实时更新。
works.idea_en: Model with distance fields the way you would with clay, without writing shader code.
works.idea_zh: 像捏黏土一样用距离场建模，而不用写着色器代码。
works.technique: A tree of SDF primitives and operators with editor controllers is compiled into an HLSL raymarching shader through a generated ShaderLab/HLSL syntax-tree API, so each gizmo edit rewrites or re-parameterises the shader.
works.technique_zh: 带编辑器控制器的 SDF 基本体和运算符树，通过自动生成的 ShaderLab/HLSL 语法树 API 编译成 HLSL 光线步进着色器，每次拖动手柄都会重写或重新设置着色器参数。
works.exercise_en: Export a scene built with SdfManipulator as a raymarched cube and place it on a table with AR Foundation, then let two fingers control the blend radius between shapes. Twist: drive one primitive with the user's hand position.
works.exercise_zh: 把 SdfManipulator 做出的场景导出成一个光线步进立方体，用 AR Foundation 放到桌面上，再让双指控制形体之间的融合半径。变体：让其中一个基本体跟随用户的手部位置。

works.title: VFX Sketchbook (Godot 4)
works.description: A montage of stylised real-time effects made in Godot 4, from fireballs, fireworks and a force field to portals, a tornado portal, butterflies and a water hand, each a small sketch.
works.description_zh: 一段 Godot 4 实时风格化特效合集：火球、烟花、力场、传送门、龙卷风传送门、蝴蝶和水之手等，每个都是一个小草图。
works.idea_en: A sketchbook habit: one quick effect at a time, all shared openly.
works.idea_zh: 速写本式的习惯：一次做一个小特效，全部公开分享。
works.technique: Each effect combines GPU particles with custom spatial shaders that scroll noise textures, erode alpha and push emissive colour, organised as reusable scenes in one project.
works.technique_zh: 每个特效都把 GPU 粒子和自定义空间着色器结合起来，滚动噪声纹理、侵蚀透明度并提高自发光颜色，作为可复用的场景组织在一个项目里。
works.exercise_en: Port one sketch to an AR-capable engine (Godot OpenXR passthrough or Unity AR Foundation) and trigger it on a real surface with a tap. Twist: chain three sketches into a spell that the user casts with a gesture sequence.
works.exercise_zh: 把其中一个草图移植到支持 AR 的引擎（Godot OpenXR 透视或 Unity AR Foundation），点一下就在真实表面上触发。变体：把三个草图串成一个法术，用户用一串手势施放。

works.title: Webcam Effect with Shader Graph
works.description: A live webcam image is fed into Shader Graph and turned into a stylised, animated effect on screen.
works.description_zh: 实时摄像头画面被送进 Shader Graph，变成屏幕上风格化的动态效果。
works.idea_en: The camera feed is just another texture you can shade.
works.idea_zh: 相机画面只是另一张可以着色的纹理。
works.technique: A script captures a WebCamTexture and assigns it to a material, and Shader Graph nodes then distort, posterise or displace the texture; an accompanying article explains the setup.
works.technique_zh: 脚本捕获 WebCamTexture 并赋给材质，再由 Shader Graph 节点对纹理进行扭曲、色调分离或位移；配套文章讲解了整个设置。
works.exercise_en: Replace the WebCamTexture with the AR Foundation camera background texture and build the same Shader Graph effect as a filter on the phone's view of the world. Twist: apply the effect only inside the human-segmentation mask.
works.exercise_zh: 把 WebCamTexture 换成 AR Foundation 的相机背景纹理，把同样的 Shader Graph 效果做成手机取景的滤镜。变体：只在人像分割遮罩内应用这个效果。

works.title: Reaction-Diffusion: Coral
works.description: Coral-like patterns grow and branch across a surface as two simulated chemicals react and diffuse in real time.
works.description_zh: 两种模拟化学物质实时反应和扩散，珊瑚般的图案在表面上生长和分叉。
works.idea_en: Two chemicals and two rates are enough to grow coral.
works.idea_zh: 两种化学物质、两个速率，就足以长出珊瑚。
works.technique: A Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion model runs in a compute shader over a pair of ping-pong textures, and the concentration drives colour and likely height for the coral look.
works.technique_zh: Gray-Scott 反应扩散模型在计算着色器里用一对交替的纹理运行，浓度决定颜色，很可能还决定高度，形成珊瑚的样子。
works.exercise_en: Grow the reaction-diffusion texture on an AR plane or the LiDAR mesh, seeding it where the user taps so coral spreads over the real room. Twist: let the feed rate follow the ambient light level.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 平面或 LiDAR 网格上生长反应扩散纹理，在用户点击的地方播种，让珊瑚蔓延到真实房间。变体：让补给率随环境光亮度变化。

works.title: Surface-Stable Fractal Dithering
works.description: A 3D scene is rendered only with black-and-white dots that stick to the surfaces as the camera moves, while the dots keep the same size on screen through fractal subdivision.
works.description_zh: 三维场景只用黑白点渲染，镜头移动时这些点牢牢贴在物体表面上，同时借助分形细分让点在屏幕上保持相同大小。
works.idea_en: Dither that belongs to the surface, not the screen.
works.idea_zh: 属于表面、而不是屏幕的抖动图案。
works.technique: A 3D dither texture of Bayer-like dot layers is sampled in surface UV space, and the shader picks the fractal level from UV derivatives so dots subdivide smoothly as surfaces get closer or farther.
works.technique_zh: 着色器在表面 UV 空间采样一张由类 Bayer 点阵层组成的三维抖动纹理，并根据 UV 导数选择分形层级，使点在表面靠近或远离时平滑细分。
works.exercise_en: Apply the dither shader to virtual objects in an AR Foundation scene and to the LiDAR room mesh, so the whole space turns into a stable one-bit engraving as you walk. Twist: map dot density to sound volume.
works.exercise_zh: 把抖动着色器用在 AR Foundation 场景的虚拟物体和 LiDAR 房间网格上，让你走动时整个空间变成稳定的一位色版画。变体：让点的密度随声音音量变化。

works.title: Volumetric Lights for Unity
works.description: Point lights and spotlights fill a hazy scene with visible light shafts and shadowed beams that react to occluders.
works.description_zh: 点光源和聚光灯让朦胧的场景里出现看得见的光柱，被遮挡的地方光束中也出现阴影。
works.idea_en: Make the air visible by marching rays through the light.
works.idea_zh: 沿着光线步进采样，让空气变得看得见。
works.technique: For each pixel the shader raymarches through the light volume at half resolution, samples the shadow map and a 3D noise at each step to accumulate in-scattering with a phase function, then upsamples bilaterally.
works.technique_zh: 着色器对每个像素以半分辨率在光照体积中做光线步进，每一步采样阴影贴图和三维噪声，用相位函数累积散射光，再做双边上采样。
works.exercise_en: Add a volumetric spotlight to an AR scene and anchor it to a real lamp detected with AR Foundation, so virtual dust glows in the beam. Twist: let the phone's flashlight direction steer the virtual beam.
works.exercise_zh: 在 AR 场景里加一个体积聚光灯，锚定到 AR Foundation 检测到的真实台灯上，让虚拟灰尘在光束中发亮。变体：让手机手电筒的方向控制虚拟光束。

works.title: Realtime Volumetric Clouds in Unity
works.description: Fluffy, sunlit clouds drift across the sky and change density and coverage in real time.
works.description_zh: 蓬松、被阳光照亮的云在天空中飘动，密度和覆盖率实时变化。
works.idea_en: Clouds are noise sampled along a ray, lit by how much sun reaches each step.
works.idea_zh: 云就是沿光线采样的噪声，每一步能接收到多少阳光决定了它的亮度。
works.technique: A raymarching shader samples 3D noise shaped by a weather map and height gradient (likely the Perlin-Worley approach from Horizon Zero Dawn) and estimates lighting at each step with a short march toward the sun; the code is the author's bachelor's thesis.
works.technique_zh: 光线步进着色器采样由天气图和高度梯度塑形的三维噪声（很可能采用《地平线：零之曙光》的 Perlin-Worley 方法），并在每一步向太阳方向做短距离步进估算光照；代码是作者的本科毕业设计。
works.exercise_en: Shrink the cloud volume to a small box and place it above a real table with AR Foundation, lit by the estimated main light direction. Twist: make it rain particles onto the table when the user blows into the microphone.
works.exercise_zh: 把云的体积缩小成一个小盒子，用 AR Foundation 放在真实桌面上方，用估计的主光方向照亮它。变体：用户对着麦克风吹气时，让它向桌面落下雨滴粒子。

works.title: VAT Utils for VFX Graph
works.description: Houdini rigid-body shatters, soft bodies and remeshing fluid simulations play back as many instanced meshes inside Unity VFX Graph.
works.description_zh: Houdini 里的刚体破碎、软体和重新网格化的流体模拟，在 Unity VFX Graph 中以大量实例化网格回放。
works.idea_en: Simulate offline, replay anywhere: baked physics becomes a real-time particle output.
works.idea_zh: 离线模拟、随处回放：烘焙好的物理变成实时粒子输出。
works.technique: SideFX Labs VAT 3.0 exports encode per-vertex positions and rotations into textures, and the package provides VFX Graph examples that use those VAT meshes as particle output with the matching shader, one per VAT type.
works.technique_zh: SideFX Labs 的 VAT 3.0 导出把逐顶点位置和旋转编码进纹理，这个包提供 VFX Graph 示例，把这些 VAT 网格作为粒子输出并配合对应着色器，每种 VAT 类型一个示例。
works.exercise_en: Bake a small Houdini shatter as a VAT, spawn it with VFX Graph on an AR Foundation plane, and replay it when the user taps a real object. Twist: spawn many copies with random time offsets so the floor keeps shattering like rain.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个小型 Houdini 破碎模拟烘焙成 VAT，用 VFX Graph 在 AR Foundation 平面上生成，用户点击真实物体时回放。变体：生成许多带随机时间偏移的副本，让地面像下雨一样不停碎裂。

works.title: Supermosh
works.description: A browser editor where clips are glitched with datamosh: motion from one shot drags the pixels of another, as shown in the author's tutorial.
works.description_zh: 一个浏览器编辑器，用 datamosh 给视频片段制造故障：一个镜头的运动拖拽着另一个镜头的像素，作者在教程里做了演示。
works.idea_en: Datamosh without codecs or command lines, right in the browser.
works.idea_zh: 不碰编解码器和命令行，直接在浏览器里做 datamosh。
works.technique: Supermosh likely decodes video in the browser, extracts per-block motion between frames and re-applies that motion to pixels of a held or different frame instead of refreshing them, reproducing the missing-keyframe glitch.
works.technique_zh: Supermosh 很可能在浏览器里解码视频，提取帧间的分块运动，再把这些运动施加到被保留的或另一段画面的像素上而不刷新它们，从而重现“缺失关键帧”的故障效果。
works.exercise_en: Recreate a real-time datamosh on a WebXR or phone camera feed by estimating motion with optical flow in a shader and advecting the previous frame instead of drawing the new one. Twist: only mosh inside a virtual portal placed in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或手机相机画面上做实时 datamosh：用着色器中的光流估计运动，并用它平流上一帧而不是绘制新帧。变体：只在房间里放置的一个虚拟传送门里做 datamosh。

works.title: Pepper's Cone
works.description: A thin plastic cone on an iPad shows a 3D object suspended inside it, and the view stays perspective-correct as the display is rotated on its base (UIST 2017 video).
works.description_zh: 在 iPad 上放一个薄塑料锥，锥里就浮现出一个三维物体；把显示器在底座上旋转时，画面始终保持正确的透视（UIST 2017 视频）。
works.idea_en: A cheap cone plus a pre-warped image makes a walk-around hologram.
works.idea_zh: 一个便宜的锥体加一张预先变形的图像，就是一个能绕着看的全息影像。
works.technique: The Unity app reads the tablet's gyroscope to know the viewer's relative orientation, renders the object from that direction and pre-distorts the image so that its reflection in the cone appears as an undistorted, perspective-correct 3D object.
works.technique_zh: Unity 应用读取平板的陀螺仪来判断观众的相对方向，从这个方向渲染物体并对图像预先变形，使它在锥面上的反射看起来是不变形、透视正确的三维物体。
works.exercise_en: Build a Pepper's-ghost pyramid or cone for a phone and feed it a pre-warped render of an AR Foundation scene, using the phone's gyroscope or front-camera face tracking to update the view. Twist: display a live 3D scan of a classmate inside the cone.
works.exercise_zh: 为手机做一个佩珀尔幻象金字塔或锥体，输入经过预变形的 AR Foundation 场景渲染，用手机陀螺仪或前置摄像头的人脸追踪更新视角。变体：在锥体里显示一位同学的实时三维扫描。

leads.name: Saki Komikado (komietty)
leads.why: Strong open Unity repos (moxi ink, CIP fluid, bitonic-sort SPH, vector fields) but old X posts are deleted and no own video exists; README GIFs only.

leads.name: Minions Art
leads.why: Influential interactive snow/grass/liquid shader tutorials with YouTube videos, but the code is shared on Patreon, not in a public repository.

leads.name: 0b5vr / FMS_Cat
leads.why: Demoscene WebGL intros and GLSL live sets (0mix, condition) with source; not Unity and not clearly AR-transferable.

leads.name: FluvioFX (Fluvio / Thinksquirrel; demo uploaded by Greg Poole)
leads.why: fluviofx (702 stars): SPH fluid dynamics inside Unity VFX Graph; a playable demo exists (youtube K5Dzxn9ztiQ) but the author/studio identity needs confirming before adding a creator record.

leads.name: Jason Tsorlinis
leads.why: BoidsUnity / BoidsWebGPU GPU boids repos; no playable video found (no README video, no social account).

leads.name: Justin Hawkins (Scrawk)
leads.why: Ceto ocean, PBD fluid, GPU fluid and marching-cubes Unity repos; no own playable video found.

leads.name: Erik Roystan Ross (IronWarrior)
leads.why: Roystan.net shader tutorials with open Unity repos (outline, toon, geometry grass, toon water, ~800–940 stars each); showcase media mostly GIFs, needs a playable video.

leads.name: Victor Meunier (MrEliptik)
leads.why: Godot developer whose godot_experiments (1k stars) and shader_experiments repos pair with YouTube/X clips of 2D, 3D and VR effects.

leads.name: Matt Dean (Kink3d)
leads.why: Copenhagen graphics programmer; open LensRain screen-space lens rain effect and other URP rendering experiments; video not yet found.

leads.name: Roel Kok
leads.why: Kinect-VFX-Graph (213 stars) streams Kinect depth into Unity VFX Graph; README GIF only, no video on YouTube or in his archived X posts (@RoelKokIntl).

leads.name: mao-test-h
leads.why: FaceTracking-VFX (ARKit face tracking + VFX Graph) and URPGlitch; README GIF / short clip only and no identifiable author or social account.
